All Candidates (Male & Female, Unmarried) Born not earlier than 01-01-2008 and not later than 01-01-2011 02-01-2008 to 01-01-2011 (both days inclusive)

Note: There is no upper age relaxation for any category (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD) in NDA & NA Examination. The age band is uniformly applicable to all candidates.

UPSC NDA 2 2026 - Application Fee

Fee is payable through online mode only (Net Banking / Visa / Master / RuPay Credit / Debit Card / UPI). Payment through any other mode is not valid. Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can it be held in reserve for any other examination.

Category Fee
General / OBC / EWS (Male) Rs. 100/- (Non-Refundable)
SC / ST Candidates NIL (Exempted)
Female Candidates (All categories) NIL (Exempted)
Wards of serving/ex-JCOs/NCOs/ORs studying in Military Schools / Sainik Schools (run by Sainik Schools Society) NIL (Exempted - certificate from Principal required for verification at SSB)

Note: No fee exemption is available to OBC/EWS male candidates; they must pay the full prescribed fee.

UPSC NDA 2 2026 - Selection Process

Selection consists of a Written Examination conducted by UPSC, followed by Intelligence and Personality Test at the Services Selection Board (SSB) including CPSS for Air Force Flying branch, and finally Medical Examination. Success at the written examination confers no right of admission to the Academy. Final allocation is based on total marks secured in both Written Examination and SSB tests, subject to eligibility, medical fitness, and merit-cum-preference.

Stage 1 - Written Examination (Objective Type)

Paper Subject Code Duration Maximum Marks
Paper I Mathematics 01 2½ Hours 300
Paper II General Ability Test (Part A: English 200 marks + Part B: General Knowledge 400 marks) 02 2½ Hours 600
Total (Written)   900
SSB Test / Interview   900

Both papers are objective type only. Mathematics and Part B of General Ability Test are set bilingually in Hindi and English. Negative marking applies: 1/3 (0.33) marks deducted for each wrong answer. Calculators, mathematical instruments, and logarithmic tables are not permitted. Candidates must use Black Ball Pen only for all writing and marking in the OMR Answer Sheet. Face authentication is mandatory at the examination venue.

Stage 2 - SSB Intelligence & Personality Test

Candidates who qualify the written examination must register on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in (same email ID as given to UPSC) to be allotted their Selection Centre and SSB date. The SSB follows a two-stage process:

  • Stage I: Officer Intelligence Rating (OIR) Tests and Picture Perception & Description Test (PP&DT). Only those who clear Stage I are admitted to Stage II.
  • Stage II: Interview, Group Testing Officer Tasks, Psychology Tests, and Conference - conducted over 4 days. Personality is assessed by the Interviewing Officer (IO), Group Testing Officer (GTO), and Psychologist, with equal weightage.

Candidates who qualify Stage II must submit original Matriculation certificate and 10+2 pass certificate or marks sheet for verification. Candidates who have opted for Air Force (Flying) shall undergo CPSS at the Selection Centre if willing. Candidates who fail CPSS or are in Habitual Wearing of Glasses (HWG) category can be considered for Air Force Ground Duty branches if willing. Travelling allowance (AC III Tier to-and-fro railway/bus fare) is paid to candidates appearing for SSB for the first time for a particular type of commission.

Stage 3 - Medical Examination

Candidates recommended by SSB undergo medical examination by a Board of Service Medical Officers. Only those declared fit are admitted to the Academy. Proceedings of the Medical Board are confidential. Candidates declared unfit will be intimated about the procedure for an Appeal Medical Board and, subsequently, a Review Medical Board. Candidates are advised to get themselves medically examined before applying to avoid disappointment at the final stage. Common defects found include wax in ears, deviated nasal septum, overweight/underweight, undersized chest, piles, tonsillitis, hydrocele/phimosis, gynaecomastia, and varicocele.

Tie-Breaking Principles:

If final marks (aggregate) are equal, the candidate securing more marks in written total is ranked higher. If still equal, by Paper II General Ability Test marks. If still equal, by age (senior ranked higher). Any remaining tie is resolved at the Commission's discretion. Marks are rounded off to two decimal digits at all stages.

UPSC NDA 2 2026 - Scheme of Examination & Syllabus (Brief)

Paper Subject / Part Key Topics
Paper I Mathematics (300 marks) Algebra, Matrices & Determinants, Trigonometry, Analytical Geometry (2D & 3D), Differential Calculus, Integral Calculus & Differential Equations, Vector Algebra, Statistics & Probability
Paper II – Part A English (200 marks) Grammar & usage, vocabulary, comprehension, cohesion in extended text
Paper II – Part B General Knowledge (400 marks) Physics (25%), Chemistry (15%), General Science (10%), History & Freedom Movement (20%), Geography (20%), Current Events (10%)

UPSC NDA 2 2026 - Training & Career Details

Selected candidates undergo 3 years of combined academic and physical training at NDA, Khadakwasla, Pune (an Inter-Service institution). Army cadets pass out with B.Sc./B.Sc.(Computer)/B.A. from Jawaharlal Nehru University; Naval and Air Force cadets pass out with B.Tech degree (awarded at subsequent Pre-Commissioning Academies). Naval Academy (INAC) candidates undergo 4 years of training and are awarded B.Tech by JNU on successful completion.

After NDA, Army cadets proceed to IMA Dehradun (1 year; Permanent Commission as Lieutenant), Naval cadets to INA Ezhimala (1 year; Sub-Lieutenant), and Air Force Flying cadets to AFA Hyderabad (1.5 years flying training; Flying Officer on probation then confirmed). Air Force Ground Duty (Tech) cadets proceed to Air Force Technical College, Bengaluru; Ground Duty (Non-Tech) to AFA Hyderabad. Stipend during training: Rs. 56,100/- per month. Insurance cover: Rs. 30 lakh (Army Group Insurance Fund) from date of joining; Rs. 1.25 Cr cover during pre-commission training at NDA/IMA level on payment of monthly AGIF subscription of Rs. 12,500/-.

UPSC NDA 2 2026 - Exam Centres

The examination will be held across 86 cities in India. Allotment of centres (except Chennai, Dispur, Kolkata, and Nagpur) is on a "first-apply-first-allot" basis with a ceiling on candidates per centre. Once a centre reaches capacity it is frozen. Candidates are advised to apply early to secure their preferred centre. No request for change of centre will be entertained after allotment. Key centres include Agartala, Agra, Ahmedabad, Aizawl, Ajmer, Aligarh, Almora, Alwar, Bareilly, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Bilaspur, Chandigarh, Chennai, Coimbatore, Cuttack, Dehradun, Delhi, Dharamshala, Dharwad, Dispur, Faridabad, Gangtok, Gaya, Ghaziabad, Gorakhpur, Gurugram, Gwalior, Hisar, Hyderabad, Imphal, Indore, Itanagar, Jabalpur, Jaipur, Jammu, Jodhpur, Jorhat, Kannur, Kanpur, Kargil, Kochi, Kohima, Kolkata, Kozhikode, Leh, Lucknow, Ludhiana, Madurai, Mumbai, Mysuru, Nagpur, Nasik, Navi Mumbai, Panaji, Patna, Port Blair, Prayagraj, Puducherry, Pune, Raipur, Rajkot, Ranchi, Sambalpur, Shillong, Shimla, Siliguri, Srinagar, Surat, Thane, Thiruvananthapuram, Tiruchirapalli, Tirupati, Udaipur, Varanasi, Vellore, Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, and Warangal.

Competition Level Analysis for UPSC NDA 2 2026

The competition level for UPSC NDA & NA II 2026 is extremely high. With only 394 vacancies open to the entire country for one of the most prestigious defence academy entries, lakhs of Class 12 students and appearing candidates compete every year. The written exam covering Mathematics at Class 12 level and a 600-mark General Ability Test (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, History, Geography, Current Affairs, and English) demands thorough preparation across all subjects simultaneously.

The SSB stage is the most demanding filter - only candidates with strong officer-like qualities, communication ability, and mental fitness succeed here. For the Air Force Flying branch, additional CPSS qualification is a significant barrier. Female candidates have very limited vacancies (24 total across all wings and INAC) making competition in that segment especially intense. Candidates with strong Maths and Science backgrounds have an advantage, but General Knowledge and English sections are equally decisive for the final merit.

Who should NOT apply for UPSC NDA 2 2026?

  • Candidates who do not fall within the age band of born between 02-01-2008 and 01-01-2011 - there is no age relaxation of any kind for any category.
  • Married candidates - only unmarried male and female candidates are eligible. Marriage after application results in disqualification even if successful in the exam.
  • Candidates studying in Class 11; only Class 12 passed or appearing candidates are eligible. Class 11 students are explicitly not eligible.
  • Candidates applying for the Navy wing, Air Force wing, or INAC who do not have Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics at 10+2 level.
  • Candidates who have previously failed CPSS/PABT and wish to apply specifically for the Air Force Flying Branch (they may apply for Ground Duty branches).
  • Candidates who habitually wear glasses and are not willing to settle for Air Force Ground Duty branches instead of Flying.
  • Candidates who have been removed/withdrawn from any training academy of Armed Forces on disciplinary grounds or for lack of officer-like qualities.
  • Candidates debarred by the Ministry of Defence from holding any type of commission in the Defence Services.
  • Candidates with permanent body tattoos on any part of the body other than the inner forearm (inside elbow to wrist) or the back/dorsal of palm.
  • Candidates who cannot meet the physical fitness standards or have common medical defects (uncorrected deviated nasal septum, significant overweight/underweight, piles, varicocele, etc.) without prior rectification; they risk rejection at the medical stage after clearing written exam and SSB.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying UPSC NDA 2 2026?

  • Entering incorrect date of birth; once submitted to UPSC it cannot be changed at any stage or in any future examination under any circumstances.
  • Not checking subject eligibility before selecting Navy, Air Force, or INAC preferences; Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics at 10+2 level are mandatory for these wings.
  • Not registering on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in with the same email ID as provided to UPSC; this is mandatory after qualifying the written examination to receive SSB centre allotment and call-up information.
  • Uploading unclear, blurred, or incorrect photographs or signatures; signatures must be done three times (one below the other) on plain white paper in black ink.
  • Indicating service preferences carelessly; preferences cannot be changed after submission and candidates are considered only for services they have indicated.
  • Not keeping the registered email ID and mobile number active; all communications including e-Admit Card and SSB call-up are sent electronically.
  • Attempting to modify the application after submission; no correction, alteration, or modification is allowed in any field once submitted.
  • Bringing mobile phones, smart/digital watches, Bluetooth devices, or any electronic gadget to the examination venue; possession even in switched-off mode is grounds for disciplinary action and ban from future examinations.
  • Not entering the examination venue at least 30 minutes before commencement; entry is closed 30 minutes prior and no late entry is permitted under any circumstance.
  • Not carrying original Matriculation and 10+2 certificates to the SSB centre; candidates without originals will not be allowed to appear for SSB interview and will be sent back at their own expense.
  • Appearing candidates who fail to submit proof of passing 12th class by 10-06-2027; their candidature will be cancelled with no extension granted on any ground.

How to Apply for UPSC NDA 2 2026

Candidates must apply online only through https://upsconline.nic.in. No other mode of application is accepted. The Online Application Portal has four modules: Account Creation, Universal Registration (URN - one-time for lifetime), Common Application Form (CAF), and Examination Specific Module. The URN generated is common for all UPSC examinations; the Application Number generated is examination-specific and must be retained. Candidates in Government Service / Armed Forces / Sainik Schools / Military Schools must inform their Head of Office / Commanding Officer / Principal in writing that they have applied.

Documents / Details Required While Applying:

  • Date of Birth as per Matriculation / Secondary School Leaving Certificate
  • Educational qualification details (Class 12 pass certificate or appearing status)
  • Aadhaar Card (strongly advised as primary ID; other options: Voter Card/EPIC, PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, School Photo ID, or any Photo ID issued by State/Central Government)
  • Passport-size photograph (uploaded) and live photograph captured via webcam
  • Signature: signed three times (one below the other) on plain white paper with black ink, scanned and uploaded
  • URN (Universal Registration Number) - generate once, valid for all UPSC exams for lifetime
  • Fee payment: Rs. 100/- for General/OBC/EWS Male via Net Banking / Debit / Credit / RuPay / UPI; NIL for Female, SC/ST, and Wards of JCOs/NCOs/ORs studying in Military/Sainik Schools
  • Service preferences (1 to 4) to be indicated carefully in the Examination Specific Module

Documents to be Carried to SSB / Kept Ready After Written Result:

  • Original Matriculation / Secondary School Examination Certificate showing date of birth
  • Original 10+2 pass certificate or marks sheet (for candidates who have passed); bonafide certificate from school/college (for appearing candidates)
  • Fee exemption certificate from Principal (for Wards of JCOs/NCOs/ORs studying in Military/Sainik Schools)
  • NOC from Commanding Officer (for Armed Forces / Naval Sailors candidates)
  • Any other documents as required by the respective Services HQ

Apply Online at: https://upsconline.nic.in

For queries: Call 011-24041001 / 011-40303444 (10:00 AM to 5:30 PM, working days, 20-05-2026 to 09-06-2026) or email [email protected]. All communications must include Name, Course Number & Year of Exam, URN, Application Number, Roll Number (if received), full name in block letters, complete postal address, and registered email ID / mobile number.

After clearing the written exam: For Army (first choice) - visit www.joinindianarmy.nic.in. For Navy (first choice) - visit www.joinindiannavy.gov.in or email [email protected]. For Air Force (first choice) - register on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in for AFSB and date selection.

Important Instructions for UPSC NDA 2 2026 Candidates

  • Applications once submitted cannot be withdrawn. No correction/alteration/modification in any field of the application is allowed after submission under any circumstances.
  • The URN Profile provides a one-time edit facility; changes to the URN profile do not reflect in applications already submitted and apply only to future applications.
  • Candidates must indicate service preferences carefully (1 to 4) in the Examination Specific Module; no addition/alteration is entertained after submission. It is mandatory to exercise at least one preference.
  • All candidates who qualify the written examination must register on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in with the same email ID as provided to UPSC to receive SSB centre allotment. Those already registered should not register again.
  • e-Admit Cards are available only on the Commission's website for download. No admit card is sent by post or email. Candidates must enter the venue at least 30 minutes before commencement; entry is closed 30 minutes prior.
  • Face authentication is mandatory at the examination venue for all candidates.
  • Use Black Ball Pen only for all writing/marking in OMR sheets. Any omission/mistake in encoding Roll Number or Test Booklet Series Code will render the answer sheet liable for rejection.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd of marks deducted for each wrong answer. Marking more than one answer is also treated as wrong. Questions left blank carry no penalty.
  • Mobile phones, smart/digital watches, pagers, Bluetooth devices, calculators, and any electronic equipment are strictly banned inside the examination premises even in switched-off mode. Infringement entails disciplinary action including permanent/specified-period ban from UPSC examinations and possible prosecution under the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024.
  • Candidates must undertake not to marry until they complete their full training. Marriage during training leads to discharge and recovery of all Government expenditure.
  • Candidates appear before SSB at their own risk and are not entitled to compensation for any injury sustained during SSB tests. Parents/guardians must sign a certificate to this effect.
  • Candidates who fail to report to the Academy within 7 days of the specified reporting date without prior written intimation will have their candidature liable for cancellation.
  • Candidates previously removed from NDA/INAC for lack of officer-like qualities or on disciplinary grounds are not eligible. Those withdrawn on medical grounds or who left voluntarily remain eligible, provided they satisfy medical and other prescribed conditions.
  • Representations on question papers and provisional answer keys can be submitted only through the Commission's website within 5 days of the examination (Day 3 to Day 7 up to 6:00 PM). No representation by email/post/hand or any other mode is accepted.
  • Government strives to have a workforce that reflects gender balance; women candidates are encouraged to apply.
  • All revisions/corrigendum (if any) will be hosted on the UPSC website only. In case of any dispute between English and Hindi versions of the notification, the English version will prevail.

The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has released Advertisement No. 03/2026, inviting online applications from eligible candidates for recruitment to 1,979 posts across 25 different post codes in various departments and autonomous bodies of the Government of NCT of Delhi. This is one of the largest DSSSB recruitment cycles in 2026, covering a wide range of profiles - from Junior Scientific Assistants in the Forensic Science Laboratory to Trained Graduate Teachers (Computer Science) in the Directorate of Education, and technical posts such as Fitter, Lift Operator, Sub Station Apprentice, and Electrical Overseer in NDMC and the Labour Department. The notification was issued on 29 May 2026 and the online application window opens on 16 June 2026.

All posts are permanent government positions under the Government of NCT of Delhi or its autonomous and local bodies. Candidates can apply online only through the DSSSB portal at dsssbonline.nic.in. The closing date for all applications is 15 July 2026. Eligibility criteria - including age, educational qualification, and experience - will be determined as on the closing date of application, i.e., 15 July 2026.

DSSSB 03/2026 Examination Scheme & Selection Process

Selection for all posts in DSSSB Advertisement 03/2026 will be through a Computer Based Test (CBT). The exam scheme is divided into three types depending on the post. Post codes 34/26, 39/26, and 40/26 (IT Assistant Grade-A, Data Processing Assistant, Data Entry Operator) will be examined under the One Tier General (I-T-G) scheme - a 2-hour paper of 200 MCQs covering General Awareness, Reasoning, Numerical Ability, Hindi, and English (40 marks each). All Forensic Science Laboratory posts, NDMC technical posts, Delhi Archives posts, and the Electrical Overseer post (i.e., post codes 21/26 to 33/26, 35/26 to 38/26, and 45/26) will follow the One Tier Technical (I-T-T) scheme - a 2-hour paper split into Section A (100 MCQs on general subjects, 100 marks) and Section B (100 MCQs on the domain subject, 100 marks). Teaching posts - TGT Computer Science, Domestic Science Teacher, TGT Special Education, and Special Educator Primary (post codes 41/26 to 44/26) - follow the One Tier Technical/Teaching scheme with the same structure, where Section B includes questions on teaching methodology and B.Ed syllabus.

Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies for every wrong MCQ answer. Questions will be bilingual (Hindi and English), except language-specific papers. The minimum qualifying marks are 40% for General/EWS, 35% for OBC (Delhi), and 30% for SC/ST/PwBD. Ex-Servicemen get an additional 5% relaxation in their respective categories, subject to a minimum of 30%.

How to Apply for DSSSB Recruitment 2026 (Advertisement No. 03/2026)

Candidates must apply online only through the official DSSSB portal at dsssbonline.nic.in. Before applying, candidates must complete a one-time registration on the portal. The same user ID and password can be used for all future DSSSB examinations - no separate registration is required for each post. However, only one online application is allowed per post code; if multiple applications are detected for the same post code, all will be rejected and the candidate may be debarred. Once an application is submitted, no corrections or modifications - including change of category - will be permitted under any circumstances.

Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date of 15 July 2026 to avoid last-minute technical issues. The application fee of ₹100 must be paid through SBI e-Pay; no other payment mode is accepted. After successful submission, candidates should download and save a printout of their application for future reference. All supporting documents (educational certificates, caste certificates, experience certificates, etc.) will be required at the time of e-dossier upload, which will be called separately after the written examination. Candidates who fail to upload their e-dossier within the given time will have their candidature cancelled with no further opportunity.

  • Visit the DSSSB portal: https://dsssbonline.nic.in
  • Complete one-time registration (if not already registered).
  • Login and select the relevant post code from Advertisement No. 03/2026.
  • Fill in all details carefully - no changes can be made after submission.
  • Pay the application fee of ₹100 via SBI e-Pay (exempted for Women/SC/ST/PwBD/ESM).
  • Upload a recent colour passport photo (plain white/off-white background, clear face, eyes open) and signature.
  • Submit and download the application form printout.
  • Exam date will be announced separately on the DSSSB website.

DSSSB 03/2026 - Reservation & OBC Certificate Rules

Reservation benefits are available for SC, ST, OBC (Delhi), EWS, PwBD, ESM, and Meritorious Sports Persons as per Government of NCT of Delhi and Central Government instructions. An important point for OBC candidates: only OBC (Delhi) candidates notified by the Government of NCT of Delhi are eligible for reservation. OBC candidates from outside Delhi will be treated as Unreserved (UR) candidates and must apply under the UR category.

OBC (Delhi) candidates must possess a valid OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate issued on or after 01/04/2026 but not later than 15/07/2026 (the closing date). For EWS candidates, an Income & Asset certificate valid for financial year 2026–27, based on income of financial year 2025–26, is required. The reservation roster, earmarking of vacancies, and PwBD post suitability are determined entirely by the respective User Departments, not by DSSSB.

DSSSB 03/2026 - Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Only one registration is allowed per candidate on the DSSSB portal. Multiple registrations will lead to cancellation of all applications.
  • Only one application per post code is allowed. Multiple applications for the same post code will result in cancellation and debarment.
  • The eligibility cut-off date is 15 July 2026 - age, qualification, experience, and all other eligibility conditions will be determined as on this date.
  • DSSSB does not verify eligibility at the application stage; candidature is accepted on a provisional basis. Verification happens at the e-dossier stage after the written examination.
  • No calculator, mobile phone, Bluetooth device, earbud, camera, smartwatch, or any other electronic gadget is allowed in the examination hall.
  • Dress code: light clothes with half sleeves, no big buttons, brooch, or badge; salwar/trouser; slippers or sandals with low heels. Shoes are not allowed.
  • Exam centres will be in Delhi/NCR and other states as decided by DSSSB.
  • DSSSB reserves the right to cancel, modify, or amend any part of the advertisement or examination at any stage.
  • In case of any discrepancy between the English, Hindi, Urdu, and Punjabi versions of the advertisement, the English version will be treated as final.
  • Candidates must regularly check the DSSSB website at https://dsssb.delhi.gov.in for updates and notifications/corrigenda.

In summary, DSSSB Advertisement No. 03/2026 offers 1,979 government job vacancies across 25 post codes in Delhi. The largest vacancy categories are TGT Computer Science (675 posts) in the Directorate of Education, Special Educator Primary (450 posts), JSA Cyber Forensic (81 posts) in the Forensic Science Laboratory, and IT Assistant Grade-A (125 posts) in the Information Technology Department. Candidates from a wide range of educational backgrounds - Class 12 pass to Master's degree holders - can find suitable posts in this advertisement. The Railway Recruitment Boards have officially released Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) No. 01/2026 for recruitment to 11127 posts of Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) under various Railway Zones, Government of India. The notification includes complete details on vacancies, eligibility, selection process, examination syllabus, medical standards, fee, and application instructions. RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

These are distributed across UR, SC, ST, OBC, and EWS categories. Ex-Servicemen (ExSM) vacancies are included within the total vacancy count and are not separately additional. The post is not suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD).

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (14-06-2026). Educational/Technical qualification certificates must be from a recognized Board/University/Institute. Candidates awaiting results of their final examination for the prescribed qualification are NOT eligible to apply. The post of ALP is not suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD). Candidates who have undergone Lasik Surgery or any other corrective eye surgery are not eligible for this post.

Educational Qualification

Option Details
Option A - Matriculation + ITI Matriculation / SSLC plus ITI from recognised institutions of NCVT/SCVT in the trades of Fitter, Electrician, Instrument Mechanic, Millwright/Maintenance Mechanic, Mechanic (Radio & TV), Electronics Mechanic, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Wireman, Tractor Mechanic, Armature & Coil Winder, Mechanic (Diesel), Heat Engine, Turner, Machinist, Refrigeration & Air-Conditioning Mechanic. OR Matriculation / SSLC plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship in the above trades.
Option B - Matriculation + Diploma/Degree in Engineering Matriculation / SSLC plus 3-year Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Automobile Engineering (or combination of these streams) from a recognised institution in lieu of ITI. Note: Degree in the above Engineering disciplines will also be acceptable in lieu of Diploma.

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age as on 01-07-2026. Age relaxation is available for various categories as detailed below. If a candidate is eligible for relaxation on more than one ground, only the maximum relaxation will be granted (not cumulative). SC, ST, and OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR vacancies will not get any age relaxation. There is no fixed limit on the number of attempts - candidates can appear as long as they are within the prescribed upper age limit.

Category Age Limit / Relaxation
General (UR) & EWS 18 to 30 years (as on 01-07-2026)
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years relaxation (max 33 years)
SC & ST 5 years relaxation (max 35 years)
Ex-Servicemen (UR & EWS) 3 years after deduction of length of service from age
Ex-Servicemen (OBC-NCL) 6 years after deduction of length of service from age
Ex-Servicemen (SC & ST) 8 years after deduction of length of service from age

Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women (UR & EWS) Maximum 35 years of age
Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women (OBC-NCL) Maximum 38 years of age
Widowed / Divorced / Judicially Separated Women (SC & ST) Maximum 40 years of age

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates are required to pay the non-refundable recruitment fee online. Fee can be paid only through online mode - internet banking, debit/credit cards, or UPI. Applications received without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected. Candidates who appear in CBT-1 will receive a refund of their examination fee (after deducting applicable bank charges) credited to their Aadhaar-seeded bank account. Candidates whose applications are rejected, or who do not appear in CBT-1, will not receive any refund.

Category Examination Fee Refund on Appearing in CBT-1

SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / Female / Transgender / Minorities / Economically Backward Class (EBC) Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Fifty only) Rs. 250/- fully refunded (deducting bank charges)

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 consists of five successive stages - First Stage CBT (CBT-1), Second Stage CBT (CBT-2), Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT), Document Verification (DV), and Medical Examination (ME). CBT-1 is a screening exam only and its marks are not counted in the final panel. The final merit list is prepared on the basis of combined marks from Part-A of CBT-2 (50% weightage) and CBAT scores (50% weightage). Negative marking of 1/3rd mark per wrong answer applies in both CBT-1 and CBT-2. There is no negative marking in CBAT.

Stage 1 - First Stage CBT (CBT-1) - Screening Only

Details Particulars
Duration 60 Minutes
Total Questions / Marks 75 Questions / 75 Marks (1 mark per question)
Type Objective MCQ - Computer Based Test
Negative Marking 1/3rd mark deducted per wrong answer
Minimum Qualifying Marks UR & EWS: 40% | OBC (NCL): 30% | SC: 30% | ST: 25%
Shortlisting for CBT-2 15 times the vacancies notified per RRB (based on CBT-1 merit, RRB-wise)
Syllabus Mathematics, Mental Ability (Reasoning), General Science (10th standard level)

Stage 2 - Second Stage CBT (CBT-2)

Part Duration Questions Nature Minimum Qualifying Marks
Part-A 90 Minutes 100 Questions / 100 Marks Competitive - marks counted for merit UR & EWS: 40% | OBC (NCL): 30% | SC: 30% | ST: 25%
Part-B 60 Minutes 75 Questions / 75 Marks Qualifying only - trade-specific 35% for all candidates irrespective of category
Total Duration 175 Questions / 2.5 Hours  

Part-A Syllabus (CBT-2): Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, Basic Science and Engineering (Engineering Drawing, Units, Measurements, Basic Electricity, Levers, IT Literacy, etc.)

Part-B Syllabus (CBT-2) - Trade-wise Qualifying Test:

Sl. No. Qualification of Candidate Trade / Subject of Choice for Part-B
1 Electrical Engineering (and combinations) Electrician, Instrument Mechanic, Wireman, Armature & Coil Winder, Refrigeration and Air-conditioning Mechanic
2 Electronics Engineering (and combinations) Electronics Mechanic, Mechanic (Radio & TV)
3 Mechanical Engineering (and combinations) Fitter, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Tractor Mechanic, Mechanic (Diesel), Turner, Machinist, Refrigeration and Air-conditioning Mechanic, Heat Engine, Millwright/Maintenance Mechanic
4 Automobile Engineering (and combinations) Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Tractor Mechanic, Mechanic (Diesel), Heat Engine, Refrigeration and Air-conditioning Mechanic

Stage 3 - Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT)

Shortlisting for CBAT 8 times the ALP vacancies per community/category per RRB (based on Part-A marks of CBT-2)
Qualifying Marks Minimum T-score of 42 in each test battery separately (all candidates irrespective of category)
Language English and Hindi only
Negative Marking No negative marking

Stage 4 & 5 - Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (ME)

Final merit list is prepared RRB-wise from candidates qualifying in CBAT, with 50% weightage to Part-A of CBT-2 marks and 50% weightage to CBAT scores. Candidates equal to the number of vacancies are shortlisted for DV and Medical Examination. In case of a tie, the older candidate is preferred; if age is also equal, alphabetical order of given name (A to Z) is applied.

Tie-Breaking Rules

1st Tie-Break Seniority of age (older candidate preferred)
2nd Tie-Break Alphabetical order (A to Z) of given name (not surname)

RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 - Medical Standards

The post of ALP carries Medical Standard A-1. Candidates must be physically fit in all respects with stringent vision requirements. Candidates who have undergone Lasik Surgery or any other corrective eye surgery are not eligible. A Self Screening Medical Declaration Report (Part-A signed by General Physician and Part-B signed by Eye Specialist, both from a Central/State Government Hospital or Medical College) must be submitted on the CBAT exam day.

Medical Standard General Fitness Vision Standards
A-1 Physically fit in all respects (i) Distant Vision: 6/6, 6/6 without glasses with fogging test (must not accept +2D); (ii) Near Vision: Sn: 0.6, 0.6 without glasses; (iii) Must pass tests for Colour Vision, Binocular Vision, Field of Vision, Night Vision, Mesopic Vision, etc.

How to Apply for RRB ALP Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the official websites of participating RRBs (listed at Para 13.7 of the CEN). Hard copy / offline applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. The online portal is active from 15-05-2026 to 14-06-2026 (23:59 Hrs.). Candidates must first create an account on the RRB portal. Those who created an account for CENs notified in 2024/2025 should use the same credentials. Details filled in the "Create an Account" form (including mobile number, email ID) and the chosen RRB cannot be modified at any stage after account creation. Candidates can apply to only one RRB and submit only one application - multiple applications to the same or different RRBs will result in rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams. Aadhaar or DigiLocker authentication is strongly advised during account creation for a smoother recruitment process. A live photograph is captured during the online application; pre-existing photographs are not accepted. No documents need to be uploaded at application stage (except signature and SC/ST certificate for free travel pass, if applicable).

Documents to be Produced at Document Verification (on being called):

  • Age proof - Matriculation / SSLC / 10th class certificate
  • Educational qualifications (Matriculation onwards) - marksheets and certificates
  • ITI / Diploma / Degree certificate in prescribed trade / discipline
  • SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS / Ex-Servicemen certificate (if applicable), in prescribed format and issued by competent authority
  • Self Screening Medical Declaration Report (Annexure VIII A & VIII B) - to be submitted on CBAT day
  • NOC from present employer (if applicable, for Government servants)

Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official RRB website for their chosen RRB for updates on all stages. Helpline for technical queries: Email: [email protected] | Phone: 0172-565-3333 and 9592001188 (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days).

Important Instructions for RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only one application per candidate is accepted - multiple applications to one or more RRBs will result in rejection of all applications and permanent debarment from RRB/RRC exams.
  • Candidates awaiting results of their final prescribed qualification examination are NOT eligible to apply.
  • Candidates who have undergone Lasik or any other corrective eye surgery are not eligible for the post of ALP.
  • Selection of RRB, once submitted, is final and cannot be changed at any later date.

  • Examination fee is refundable (after deducting bank charges) only to candidates who appear in CBT-1; rejected or absent candidates are not eligible for refund.
  • Refund will be credited only to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account; candidates must ensure their Aadhaar is linked to an active bank account.

Competition Level Analysis for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026

The competition level for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 is expected to be moderate to high. The recruitment is restricted to Male candidates only, which reduces the applicant pool compared to open-gender recruitments. However, 899 vacancies across technical/trade posts will attract a large number of ITI-qualified and Matriculation-level candidates, especially for high-vacancy posts like Store Keeper Technical (300) and Operator Communication (261). The written exam followed by PET and Trade Test provides multiple elimination stages, but candidates with relevant ITI trade certificates and physical fitness will have a clear advantage. Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Agniveers get significant age relaxation and weightage, which makes certain trades more competitive in that segment.

The key differentiator here is the offline application process - many eligible candidates may miss out due to postal delays or incorrect application format, effectively reducing actual competition at the written exam stage. Candidates who submit complete and correct applications well before the deadline and prepare trade-specific written exam syllabi will have a significant edge.

Who should NOT apply for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026?

  • Female candidates - this recruitment is strictly for Indian National Males only.
  • Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational/technical qualification as on the closing date of application; those awaiting final exam results are not eligible.
  • Candidates outside the age band 18-27 years as on 01 Jun 2026 (except those eligible for applicable category-based relaxation).
  • OBC candidates from the Creamy Layer - they are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation and must apply as UR/General category.
  • Candidates who cannot meet the region-wise physical standards (height, chest, weight) as physical fitness is mandatory for induction.
  • Candidates with permanent medical conditions listed as grounds for permanent rejection (colour blindness for Drivers/Operators, cardiac conditions, gross myopia, etc.) who cannot pass the Primary Medical Examination at GREF Centre.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to be posted anywhere in India, especially in remote, high-altitude, or difficult terrain areas in Northern and Eastern regions.
  • Candidates who cannot arrange and send a physical application form with photograph, thumb impression, signature, fee e-receipt, and attested copies by post to Pune - there is no online application mode.
  • Candidates with tattoos on any body part other than the inner forearm (inside elbow to wrist) or reverse palm - tattoos on other parts lead to disqualification at PME.
  • Ex-servicemen who have already joined Govt civil service using ESM benefits and are claiming ESM status again - such candidates are treated as civilian employees.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying BRO GREF Recruitment 2026?

  • Not printing the application form on A4 size 75 GSM bond paper (one side only) and admit card on both sides of a single paper as mandated - non-standard paper leads to rejection.
  • Applying without attaching the e-receipt copy of the application fee paid via SBI Collect; no other payment mode is accepted and missing receipt causes rejection.
  • Sending the application from a wrong/old address instead of present postal address - applications posted from wrong address are rejected to prevent fraudulent claims of 60-day receipt benefit.
  • Not superscribing the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR (NAME OF TRADE/POST) Under Category (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/ESM/CPL)" as required - unlabelled envelopes may be misdirected.
  • Mismatch between name in application and name in Matriculation certificate - even a dropped or added part of the name requires a Gazette Notification; otherwise candidature is summarily cancelled.
  • Submitting multiple applications for the same post with different details or photographs - this results in lifetime debarment from all GREF examinations.
  • OBC/EWS certificate dated older than one year from the closing date - OBC and EWS certificates must be fresh (not older than one year as on closing date) and in the prescribed Central Govt format.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post/trade using the same envelope - each post requires a separate application with separate fee in a separate envelope.
  • Not carrying the minimum 12 passport-size photographs (same as pasted on application and admit card) to all subsequent recruitment stages - shortage of photos causes disruption at PET/TT/PME stages.
  • Ignoring the trade-specific syllabus and treating the written exam as a general knowledge test - each post has a distinct subject-wise syllabus and candidates must prepare trade-specific topics.

How to Apply for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply offline only; no online application mode is available. Application form and admit card must be downloaded from the official BRO website (www.bro.gov.in) and filled in English or Hindi only, in capital letters. The application form must be printed on A4 size 75 GSM bond paper (one side only) and admit card printed on both sides of a single paper. Candidates must first pay the application fee online via SBI Collect portal and attach the e-receipt copy. Candidates applying for more than one post must send separate applications with separate fee in separate envelopes. Candidates are strongly advised to send applications well before the closing date and not wait for the last day - GREF Centre will not be responsible for postal delays.

Candidates should read the detailed instructions and guidelines available at https://bfsissc.com before applying.

  • Proof of residence/domicile (for correct physical standards region)
  • Any certificate in language other than Hindi or English must be enclosed with an attested Hindi/English translation by a Group A Gazetted Officer

Send Application (by Postal Service) to: Commandant, GREF Centre, Dighi Camp, Pune - 411015

Important Instructions for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Male Indian Nationals can apply; Female candidates are not eligible.
  • Application form and/or admit card without signature, without photograph, or without thumb impression will be summarily rejected - no communication will be done for rejected applications.
  • Candidates must ensure their Aadhaar Card photo is current (not older than 2-3 years from written exam date) and address/phone is updated; outdated Aadhaar may prevent entry to the exam.
  • Son of Serving / Ex-GREF staff should write father's GS No., Rank, and Name on top of the application in red ink with a photocopy of relationship certificate, to claim the 15% weightage benefit.
  • Casual Paid Labours (CPL) of GREF who have worked for 179 days in the last one year and are on the Muster Roll on the date of advertisement publication get 10% additional weightage - attach experience certificate signed by OC unit, countersigned by Commander BRTF and verified by Accounts Officer.

  • OBC candidates belonging to Creamy Layer are not entitled to reservation; they should apply under UR category.
  • Candidates serving in other Government Departments must apply through proper channel sufficiently in advance; applications not received by due date through proper channel will be rejected.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, and all electronic/communication devices are strictly NOT ALLOWED inside GREF Centre, Pune campus during any recruitment process.
  • A candidate who absents himself during any recruitment activity for which he has been called will have his candidature cancelled automatically - he will not be allowed to appear for further stages.

BOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection for engagement of apprentices will be based on three stages - Online Examination, Document Verification, and Test of local language of the State. Candidates must qualify all three stages. Final selection is subject to medical fitness as per the Bank's requirements. Applications must be submitted online only. No other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the Government Apprenticeship portals - NATS (https://nats.education.gov.in) and/or NAPS (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in).

The application registration is considered complete only when fee/charges are deposited with BFSI SSC. Candidates must note down their Enrolment Id (NATS portal) and Apprentice Registration Code (NAPS portal) for all future correspondence.

Important Instructions for Bank of Baroda Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • This is NOT regular employment or contract employment in the Bank. Apprentices will be TRAINEES only and not employees of Bank of Baroda.
  • The apprentice shall have no right to claim employment in the Bank after completion of training. Bank of Baroda has no obligation to offer regular employment to apprentices during or after the apprenticeship period.
  • Candidates can apply for engagement as apprentice in one State/UT only. Allotment to a different State/UT will not be considered under any circumstances.

The maximum age of the candidate should not exceed 55 years (for posts with absolute cap) or not exceed General age limit + 10 years (cumulative relaxation cap) as applicable to the respective post.

BPCL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The multi-stage selection process will be adopted based on the number of applications received for each profile. Final selection is subject to document verification, performance in all selection stages, and Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

Applications will be screened on the basis of years of relevant work experience, educational qualification, and other eligibility criteria as specified for each profile.

Stage 2 – Computer Based Test (CBT)

Stage 3 – Case Based Discussion / Group Task / Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted in the CBT (category-wise and discipline-wise merit list) will be called for Case Based Discussion and/or Group Task and/or Personal Interview. Document verification shall be conducted before this stage. Provisional selection will be based on relevant work experience, on-the-job achievements, and overall performance across all selection stages.

Stage 4 – Pre-Employment Medical Examination

Provisionally selected candidates must clear a Pre-Employment Medical Examination conducted by BPCL’s authorized doctor / nominated hospital as per OISD-GDN-166 guidelines. Medical fitness decision shall be final and binding. Reference for medical examination does not mean final selection.

How to Apply for BPCL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online only; no other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must read the detailed advertisement carefully before applying. All details entered in the online form will be treated as final and no changes will be entertained after submission.

This is not applicable for candidates already in Central / State Government Services / PSUs.

  • BPCL reserves the right to cancel / restrict / enlarge / modify / alter the recruitment process at any stage without notice.

Certification Engineers International Limited (CEIL), Head Office, Navi Mumbai has officially released Advertisement No. CEIL/HR&A/Advt./2026-27/01 for engagement of multiple technical and non-technical personnel on Fixed Term Contract basis. CEIL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Additional: For Mechanical/Production – ASNT Level-II in NDT Methods (UT, RT, MPT, PT) is mandatory; ASNT Level-III / CSWIP 3.1 / PAUT preferred. For E&I – NACE Level-I / Level-II preferred.

Officer Grade-II (Office Management) Engineering Graduate or Diploma in Mechanical / Production / Civil / IT / CS / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunication / Instrumentation with minimum 50% marks Relevant experience with good communication skills (written and oral), Computer knowledge in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), hands-on experience of secretarial works to MD / Director / Owner / Higher official, preparation of presentations. Should have experience in managing the CEO's calendar end-to-end and planning domestic and international travel itineraries as per PSU norms.

CEIL Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The notification does not mention any application fee. Applications are to be submitted online free of charge through CEIL's official recruitment portal at https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/.

CEIL Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Applications received will be put up to a Committee for shortlisting. Screening and selection will be based on the details provided in the application form - only accurate, full and correct information should be furnished. Furnishing of wrong/false information will result in disqualification.

For Officer Grade Posts (QA/QC, Safety, Marketing, SCM, Office Management): Shortlisting based on application details, followed by Personal Interview. Interviews will be held at CEIL office, Navi Mumbai. Online interviews (Skype, Google Meet, or similar) may also be conducted if required.

For HR Associate Category: Selection will be done through Written Test. Candidates complying with the criteria will be shortlisted for the written test.

CEIL may restrict the number of candidates called for interview / written test based on academic excellence, age, and experience. Selected candidates will be on panel and appointment letters will be issued as per requirement.

Who should NOT apply for CEIL Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not hold an Engineering Degree or Diploma in the relevant discipline with minimum 50% marks - this is a hard requirement for all technical posts.
  • Mechanical/Production QA/QC candidates who do not have ASNT Level-II certification in NDT methods (UT, RT, MPT, PT) - this is mandatory and non-negotiable.
  • Candidates who do not have the prescribed minimum post-qualification experience as on 30.04.2026 - experience counted is post-PQ only.
  • Candidates exceeding the maximum age limit for their respective grade and discipline (Degree or Diploma holder category) as on 30.04.2026.
  • Candidates looking for a permanent government job - this is a Fixed Term Contract with no liability on CEIL for regular appointment at any stage; total contract period will not exceed 36 months under any circumstances.
  • Candidates not willing to serve anywhere in India - posting can be at any CEIL office or project site across India at the discretion of management.
  • OBC candidates from creamy layer - only OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates are eligible for reservation benefits.
  • PwD candidates with less than 40% disability - minimum 40% disability is required for PwD relaxation benefits.
  • Candidates without a valid and functional email ID that can remain active for at least 24 months from date of application - all communications will be via email only.
  • Candidates for the Safety Officer post without a Degree/Diploma in Industrial Safety in addition to the engineering degree - both are mandatory.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying for CEIL Recruitment 2026?

  • Not checking ASNT Level-II certification status before applying for Mechanical/Production QA/QC posts - it is mandatory and absence will disqualify the application.
  • Miscalculating experience years - experience must be post-qualification (after engineering degree/diploma) and is counted as on 30.04.2026, not the date of application.
  • Applying with CGPA/OGPA without converting to equivalent percentage - candidates must indicate the equivalent percentage as per university/institute norms and be ready to produce documentary proof at interview.
  • Applying through any mode other than CEIL's official recruitment portal (https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/) - applications through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • Providing an incorrect or inactive email ID - all communications including interview/test intimation will be via email only; CEIL will not be responsible for loss of communication due to invalid email.
  • Applying for Grade-II posts in Marketing, SCM, or Office Management without adequate experience in those specific functional areas - engineering qualification alone is not sufficient; relevant functional experience is mandatory.
  • Not keeping track of CEIL's official website www.ceil.co.in - any change in last date or other schedule will be communicated only through the website, not separately.
  • Attending the interview without carrying all original documents - absence of any required document (age proof, marksheets, experience certificates, salary slip, category certificate) will result in disqualification from interview.
  • Canvassing in any form - this will immediately result in disqualification.
  • Not preparing 5 copies of the Annexure (CV format) - shortlisted candidates will need to bring 5 copies of the Annexure, which will be sent only to shortlisted candidates by CEIL.

How to Apply for CEIL Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online only through CEIL's official recruitment portal. Applications received through any other mode shall not be entertained. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date. Applications found incomplete or received after the due date are liable to be rejected.

Documents Required at the time of Interview:

  • Proof of Age (10th / Matriculation certificate)
  • Educational and Professional Qualifications (all marksheets & certificates)
  • Service Certificate of past employment, proof of date of joining & continuity in present organization (if applicable) & latest salary slip
  • Medical Certificate for PwD (if applicable) with photograph from competent authority, confirming minimum 40% disability
  • SC / ST / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate from competent authority (OBC certificate must clearly state non-creamy layer status)
  • EWS certificate from competent authority
  • 5 copies of duly filled Annexure / CV (format sent to shortlisted candidates only)

Apply Online at: https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/

For further updates: Visit www.ceil.co.in → Careers section

Important Instructions for CEIL Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • This is a Fixed Term Contract engagement - purely on a temporary basis. It does not carry any liability on CEIL for regular appointment at any stage. Total contract period will not exceed 36 months under any circumstances.
  • Initial appointment is for one year, extendable (if required) for another 36 months or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance.
  • Selected candidates will initially be posted at CEIL Head Office, Navi Mumbai but may be posted at any CEIL office or project site anywhere in India at management's discretion. Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India need apply.
  • No perks or allowances other than the consolidated salary are payable. In case of extension beyond one year, increment @ 3% per year will be considered for the next 2 years.
  • Fixed Term Personnel must take Medical Insurance of minimum ₹2,00,000/- for self; the premium will be reimbursed by CEIL.
  • CGPA/OGPA/CPI or letter grade in Degree must be converted to equivalent percentage as per university/institute norms and documentary proof will be required at interview.
  • No TA/DA will be given for attending interviews.
  • Candidates must be of sound health; Medical Fitness Certificate from Government Hospital / Company Nominated Hospital is required at the time of joining (expense reimbursable on original receipt).
  • Contractual engagement may be terminated by CEIL at any time at its sole discretion without assigning any reason if performance/conduct is found unsatisfactory.
  • For termination during currency of contract, one month's written notice or one month's consolidated pay in lieu thereof shall be given by either party.
  • Reservation and relaxation for PwDs shall be as per GOI guidelines. Persons with 40% or more disabilities are eligible.
  • Experience prescribed is relaxable at the discretion of CEIL for SC/ST candidates.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • Number of vacancies indicated are only tentative; CEIL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/modify/alter selection/recruitment process at any stage without notice.
  • CEIL also reserves the right to reject any candidature without assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment will be under the jurisdiction of Mumbai court only.

Recruitment is on both Regular basis and Contractual basis (yearly, extendable up to 3 years). The deadline to submit applications is within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News.

Eligibility Criteria & Job Requirements

The Principal,
Sainik School Ghorakhal,
PO- Ghorakhal, Distt- Nainital (Uttarakhand)

Applications must reach the Principal within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News. Hand-delivered and late applications will not be accepted. The school will not be responsible for postal delays.

Key Highlights

  • Vacancy: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) is hiring 20 Project Engineers across Electronics (10), Mechanical (5), and Computer Science (5) disciplines.
  • Qualification: First Class BE/B.Tech in the relevant discipline with minimum 1 year post-qualification experience.
  • Interview Date: Walk-in Interview on 6th & 7th June 2026, reporting at 09:00 AM (last entry 02:00 PM).
  • Salary: ₹30,000/- per month in the first year, rising up to ₹39,000/- by the fourth year.
  • Age Limit: Maximum 28 years for UR/EWS candidates as on 07 May 2026.
  • Selection: Direct Walk-in Interview; no online application.
  • Job Type: Temporary/Contract (initially 1 year, extendable up to 4 years).

Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) has released the BDL Recruitment 2026 Notification (Advt No. BDL/C-HR (TA & CP)/2026-1) on 27th May 2026 at the official website bdl-india.in. A total of 20 vacancies have been announced for the post of Project Engineer across Electronics (10 posts), Mechanical (5 posts), and Computer Science (5 posts) disciplines. The selection will be through a Walk-in Interview on 6th and 7th June 2026 at The Aeronautical Society of India (AeSI), Bengaluru. The upper age limit is 28 years for UR/EWS candidates as on 07.05.2026. Monthly salary starts at ₹30,000/- in the first year, rising up to ₹39,000/- by the fourth year. Candidates must hold a First Class BE/B.Tech in the relevant discipline with a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification experience.

How to Apply for BDL Recruitment 2026?

BDL Project Engineer 2026 is a Walk-in Interview - there is no online application form. Candidates must appear directly at the venue with all required documents. Follow these steps:

  1. Download the official BDL Recruitment 2026 notification PDF from bdl-india.in → HR section.
  2. Download and print the Bio-data Form (Annexure-I) attached to the notification.
  3. Fill the Bio-data Form in capital letters, affix a recent passport-size colour photograph, and self-attest all required documents.
  4. Calculate your age as on 07.05.2026 and verify that you meet the upper age limit for your category.
  5. Arrange one set of self-attested photocopies of all required documents (originals must also be carried for verification).
  6. Reach The Aeronautical Society of India (AeSI), Suranjan Das Road, New Tippasandra, Bengaluru - 560075 (near Vivekananda Metro Station) by 09:00 AM on the interview date.
  7. Submit your Bio-data Form and documents at the registration desk. Documents will be scrutinised to verify eligibility.
  8. Eligible candidates will be called for the interview on the same day or a later day (candidates may need to stay more than one day at their own expense).
  9. No TA or DA will be paid. Mobile phones and electronic devices are not permitted inside the venue.

Queries: Email [email protected] with subject line: Query-BDL/Walk-in/2026-1

BDL Project Engineer 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

What is the Age Limit for BDL Project Engineer 2026?

The upper age limit for BDL Project Engineer 2026 is reckoned as on 07.05.2026. Age relaxation is available as per Government of India rules.

Category Upper Age Limit
UR / EWS 28 years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 31 years (+3 years relaxation)
SC / ST 33 years (+5 years relaxation)
PwBD (over & above category relaxation) +10 years additional relaxation
Ex-Servicemen Military service period + 3 years
J&K Domicile (01.01.1980-31.12.1989) +5 years relaxation

What is the Educational Qualification for BDL Project Engineer 2026?

Candidates must hold a First Class (60%) BE / B.Tech / B.Sc Engg (4 years) / Integrated M.E. / M.Tech in the relevant discipline from an AICTE-approved institution. For SC/ST candidates applying against reserved posts, 55% marks are sufficient.

Post Equivalent Disciplines Accepted
Project Engineer (Electronics) Electronics Engg; Electronics & Communication Engg; Electronics & Instrumentation Engg; Electronics Design & Technology Engg; Applied Electronics Engg; Electronics & Telecommunication Engg; Electronics & Control Engg
Project Engineer (Mechanical) Mechanical Engg; Industrial & Production Engg; Mechanical Production & Tool Engg; Production Engg; Production Technology Manufacturing Engg; Production & Industrial Engg; Manufacturing Technology; Aerospace Engg; Aeronautical Engg
Project Engineer (Computer Science) Computer Science Engineering

No rounding off allowed (59.99% is not treated as 60%). Academic / Teaching / Internship / Project Work experience will NOT count as industrial experience.

What is the Experience Requirement for BDL Project Engineer 2026?

All posts require a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification industrial experience in the relevant domain. Key areas per discipline:

Post Required Experience Areas
Electronics Embedded systems, RF, Power Electronics, Schematic / Troubleshooting, system design, LabVIEW, Control systems, FPGA, C, C++, VC++, Software development, weapon checkout system
Mechanical CAD (SolidWorks, AutoCAD, CATIA, MATLAB), FEA, Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics, Heat Transfer, Material Science, 3D Modelling & Simulation, Product Development, Machine Design, Quality Control, ASME/ISO compliance
Computer Science Application Software development for weapon systems; FPGA/VHDL, C, C++, VC++, Python, ADA, HILLS, Dspace, NI Veristand, ETAS, LABCAR, Opal-RT; Testing tools: LDRA, POLYSPACE, DO178STDS, OPEL RT (RTLAB)

BDL Project Engineer 2026 - Salary

BDL Project Engineer salary starts at ₹30,000/- per month in the first year and increases to ₹39,000/- per month by the fourth year, plus an annual allowance of ₹10,000/- for medical, attire, and footwear expenses.

Post 1st Year 2nd Year 3rd Year 4th Year
Project Engineer (All Disciplines) ₹30,000/- pm ₹33,000/- pm ₹36,000/- pm ₹39,000/- pm

In addition, ₹10,000/- per year is paid in two instalments towards medical insurance premium, attire allowance, stitching charges, and footwear allowance. The contract is initially for 1 year, extendable up to a maximum of 4 years based on organisational requirement and individual performance.

BDL Project Engineer 2026 - Selection Process

Selection for BDL Project Engineer 2026 is based on a total of 100 marks across three components. The minimum qualifying marks are 60% (with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD as per Government rules).

  • 75 Academic Marks - (1 mark per % of degree, max 75)
  • 10 Post-Qualification Experience (1yr=3 pts · 2yr=6 pts · 3yr+=10 pts)
  • 15 Walk-in Interview Performance

Candidates must bring one set of self-attested photocopies along with all original documents for verification at the walk-in interview venue.

  • Duly filled Bio-data Form (Annexure-I) with recent passport-size colour photograph
  • Aadhaar Card
  • Proof of Date of Birth / SSC Certificate / Matriculation Marksheet
  • Intermediate / XII / Diploma Certificate & Marks Memo(s)
  • BE / B.Tech / B.Sc Engg. Certificate & Marks Memo(s)

  • Experience Certificate indicating date of joining and date of leaving / Offer of Appointment + Last 3 months' Pay Slips
  • Mandatory Salary Proof: Bank statement showing monthly salary credit / PF Statement / ESI Statement for the claimed experience period
  • Percentage equivalent certificate or specialisation certificate (if CGPA / no specialisation mentioned in degree)
  • OBC (NCL) Certificate issued on or after 01-04-2026
  • EWS Income & Asset Certificate valid for FY 2026-27 (based on FY 2025-26 verification)

  • Qualification: MBA (Personnel/Finance) or PG Degree/Diploma in Personnel Management/HR/Finance from a recognized university/AICTE-approved institution.

The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), a statutory body under the administrative control of the Government of India, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution (Department of Consumer Affairs), has released an official advertisement for Section Officer positions.

This recruitment is on a deputation basis for eligible serving employees of Central Govt./State Govt./Union Territory Govt./Statutory/Autonomous Bodies. The deadline to submit applications is within 45 days from the date of release of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.

Eligibility Criteria & Job Requirements

Candidates must fulfill the minimum qualifications and service conditions specified by BIS:

Service Eligibility

  • Option A: Persons holding an analogous post on a regular basis.
  • Option B: Candidates in Level-6 of the Pay Matrix with 3 years of regular service.

Educational Qualification

  • Option A: Master of Business Administration (MBA) with Personnel/Finance specialization of two years' duration from a recognized university/AICTE-approved institution.
  • Option B: Post Graduate Degree/Post Graduate Diploma in Personnel Management/Human Resource Management/Finance of two years' duration from a recognized university/AICTE-approved institution.

Age Limit & Other Conditions

Maximum Age: 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

Departmental Candidates: BIS's own departmental candidates are not eligible to apply for deputation posts.

Place of Posting: BIS reserves the right to modify the number of posts and place of posting, and may transfer candidates across any BIS office in India as per organizational requirement.

BIS Selection Methodology

The selection process for the Section Officer post is as follows:

  1. Initial Screening: Applications will be screened based on eligibility criteria, qualifications, and experience submitted through proper channel.
  2. Documents Required with Application: Attested copies of last 5 years' APAR dossiers, Vigilance Clearance Certificate, and Integrity Certificate duly signed by the appropriate authority must be forwarded by the concerned authority along with the application.
  3. Final Selection: Based on assessment of applications and documents submitted through proper channel.

How to Apply for BIS Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must submit applications through proper channel (Forwarding Authority) via Speed Post only:

  1. Fill the application form in the prescribed proforma given in Annexure-I in capital letters.
  2. Attach attested copies of certificates relating to age, caste/category, qualifications, and experience.
  3. Complete the Declaration (Annexure-II) and ensure the Forwarding Authority countersigns with the certificate.
  4. The Forwarding Authority must enclose: (i) attested copies of last 5 years' APARs, (ii) Vigilance Clearance Certificate, and (iii) Integrity Certificate.
  5. Send the application only by Speed Post, superscribing the envelope: "The application for the post of Section Officer on Deputation", within 45 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar, to:

Director (Establishment),
Bureau of Indian Standards,
Manak Bhavan, 9, Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg,
New Delhi – 110002

What Is CSEB Kerala? - Understanding the Recruitment Process

The Cooperative Service Examination Board (CSEB), Kerala, is the state body that conducts recruitment examinations for vacancies in Kerala's cooperative banks and societies. Unlike PSC (Public Service Commission) which recruits for government departments, CSEB specifically handles the cooperative sector.

The recruitment process works in two layers:

  1. CSEB conducts the written examination and prepares a ranked list of qualified candidates for each advertisement
  2. The individual cooperative bank/society conducts the interview from the shortlisted candidates and makes the final appointment

This means that after you clear the written exam, the specific bank where the vacancy exists will call you for an interview. Final appointment is made by that bank - you are an employee of the cooperative bank, not a Kerala Government employee. However, the salary scales, service conditions, and regulations are governed by the Kerala Cooperative Societies Act and rules.

Why Apply for a Kerala Cooperative Bank Job?

Many candidates overlook cooperative bank jobs while focusing only on PSC or central government posts. Here is why CSEB recruitment deserves serious consideration:

  • Stable, permanent employment governed by the Kerala Co-operative Societies Act
  • Pay scales competitive with state government Level equivalents for the same qualifications
  • Local posting - most cooperative banks post staff within the district or region, unlike state government transfers
  • Less competition than PSC exams - the candidate pool for CSEB exams is significantly smaller than for state-level PSC recruitments
  • Multiple banks in one advertisement - you can apply to multiple institutions in the same advt by paying an additional ₹50 per bank, increasing your selection chances significantly
  • Fresher-friendly - the Junior Clerk posts especially have no experience requirement

Tips for CSEB Written Exam Preparation

  • The 100-question, 100-mark written exam typically covers: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, Kerala-specific awareness, Cooperative law and principles, Mathematics/Reasoning, and English/Malayalam language
  • For Secretary and Assistant Secretary posts, expect questions on cooperative management, accounting principles, banking regulations, and the Kerala Cooperative Societies Act in depth
  • For Junior Clerk posts, the pattern is closer to a standard clerical aptitude test - reasoning, basic arithmetic, language comprehension
  • For System Administrator, expect technical questions on networking, OS administration, database management, and IT security alongside cooperative awareness
  • For DEO, expect typing/computer knowledge components alongside the written test
  • The minimum qualifying score is low (4/20 for interview eligibility) but the real competition is in clearing the cutoff that gets you called for an interview - typically much higher in popular banks. Focus on scoring in the top tier rather than just qualifying.

Can You Apply for Multiple Banks in the Same Advertisement?

Yes - and this is a significant strategic advantage. Unlike most government recruitment processes where you apply to one organization, the CSEB system allows a single candidate to apply to multiple cooperative banks under the same advertisement number. Each additional bank beyond the first requires an extra ₹50 exam fee.

For example, under Advt. 17/2026 (Junior Clerk – Super Grade), if you want to be considered for 3 banks, you pay: ₹150 (first bank) + ₹50 + ₹50 = ₹250 (+ 18% GST).

This is particularly useful for candidates who are flexible about work location within Kerala, as it dramatically increases the number of vacancies you are effectively competing for.

Sourced from official CSEB Kerala notifications Advt. No. 15/2026 to 21/2026, issued by the Cooperative Service Examination Board, Thiruvananthapuram, dated May 30, 2026.

Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection for engagement of apprentices will be merit-based on HSC/10+2 marks. No written examination is conducted. Final selection is subject to verification of eligibility, district-wise vacancy availability, and medical fitness. In case of a tie in marks, candidates will be ranked by age in descending order within their respective category, state, and district.

Stage 1 - Merit List (Based on HSC / 10+2 Marks)

Candidates who fulfill minimum eligibility criteria will be placed in a merit list in descending order of their 10+2 marks, drawn State-wise, District-wise, and Category-wise. No written examination is conducted for this recruitment. Candidates must select their preferred State and District in the application itself. In case of equal marks, tie-break is by age in descending order within the respective category, state, and district.

Stage 2 - Document Verification

Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through email only and must appear for document verification at their own expense. Original documents along with self-attested photocopies must be produced. Candidates failing to produce originals will not be allowed to proceed further.

Stage 3 - Medical Examination

Engagement of selected apprentices is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank.
