Competition Level Analysis for Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The competition level for PSB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is expected to be moderate to high. With only 635 seats spread across 29 States/UTs, the vacancy count is significantly lower than comparable bank apprenticeship drives such as SBI. Selection is purely merit-based on 10+2 marks without any written examination, which means candidates with high HSC scores - especially from states like Uttar Pradesh (100 seats), Punjab (90 seats), Bihar (40 seats), Maharashtra (30 seats), and Haryana (50 seats) - will face intense competition within their district and category.

Since there is no written exam, the effective competition depends entirely on the candidate's 10+2 percentage and age as a tie-breaker. Attrition at later stages will occur through local language proof verification, document verification, and medical fitness, which will reduce the final eligible pool. Candidates who do not have proof of studying the local language at 8th/10th/12th level are at a disadvantage as they must demonstrate local language proficiency separately.

Who should NOT apply for Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates looking for a permanent job; this is a 12-month apprenticeship only, with no guarantee of absorption or regular employment in the Bank.
  • Candidates who have already completed any Apprenticeship (in PSB or any other organisation) or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act.
  • Candidates who have completed Post Graduate (PG) qualification - PG holders are explicitly not eligible.
  • Candidates with 1 year or more of work/job experience after completion of educational qualification.
  • Candidates who have completed more than 5 years after passing their qualifying examination.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 20–28 years as on 01-05-2026, except those eligible for notified relaxation under SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/widow/1984 riot victim categories.
  • Aspirants who do not hold a Regular Graduation degree from a recognized University/Institute by 06-06-2026.
  • Candidates not proficient in the local language of the State/UT they are applying for, and who cannot produce 8th/10th/12th or graduation-level certificate evidencing study of that language.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to register with 100% completed profile on both NAPS (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) and NATS (nats.education.gov.in) portals before applying - this is a mandatory prerequisite.
  • Candidates without a valid Aadhaar number, as it is mandatory before engagement/contract signing.
  • Candidates applying with a Ration Card or Learner's Driving License as ID proof - these are not accepted as valid identity documents for this process.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

  • Not completing 100% profile on both NAPS and NATS portals before applying; incomplete portal profiles will render the candidate ineligible.
  • Applying for a wrong State or District where the candidate is not proficient in the local language and cannot produce language study certificates.
  • Entering the wrong category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR); category cannot be changed after submission and any mismatch at document verification can lead to cancellation.
  • OBC candidates from the creamy layer applying under OBC reservation instead of UR; only Non-Creamy Layer OBC candidates with a valid, recent certificate are entitled to reservation.
  • Uploading blurred or incorrect photograph, signature, thumb impression or handwritten declaration (wrong size, format, or written by someone else) leading to rejection at scrutiny.
  • Using an invalid or inactive mobile number or email ID, resulting in failure to receive OTPs, shortlisting intimations, or further communication from the Bank.
  • Submitting multiple applications; only the last valid completed application will be retained and fees paid for other registrations will be forfeited.
  • Signing the application in CAPITAL LETTERS; signatures in capital letters are not acceptable and must match across all documents and correspondence.
  • Forgetting to note down the Enrollment ID generated on the NATS portal, which is mandatory to be mentioned while applying for training seats.
  • Not reading the clause that this is not regular employment, and later disputing about permanent absorption after the 12-month apprenticeship ends.

How to Apply for Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online through the Bank's website (https://punjabandsind.bank.in/) only. No other mode of application will be accepted. Before applying, candidates must mandatorily complete 100% registration on both the NAPS portal (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/) and the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in/). Candidates must also note down their Enrollment ID generated on the NATS portal as it is required while applying.

Documents Required to be Scanned and Uploaded:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (to be signed across by the candidate on printing)
  • Signature with black ink on white paper (Signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted)
  • Left Thumb Impression on white paper with black or blue ink
  • Handwritten Declaration in English on white paper with black ink - text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Live photograph captured via webcam or mobile phone (to be uploaded at time of online application)
  • Image files must be in .jpg / .jpeg format; scanned documents must be in PDF format only

Documents to be Produced at the time of Document Verification / Joining:

  • Xth / Date of Birth certificate in support of Date of Birth
  • Printout of application form
  • All certificates and mark sheets of educational qualification from Standard Xth, XII, and Graduation onwards
  • Caste Certificate in prescribed Government of India format for SC/ST candidates
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in prescribed format, valid as on date of joining (issued within one year prior to joining); OBC Caste Name must tally with Central Government list
  • Income and Asset Certificate in prescribed format issued by competent authority, valid EWS certificate for the financial year, for EWS category candidates
  • Disability Certificate in prescribed format issued by District Medical Board for PwBD candidates
  • Age relaxation proof with valid documents (e.g., District Magistrate certificate for 1984 riot-affected persons)
  • Photo Identity Proof (PAN Card / Passport / Permanent Driving License / Voter’s Card / Bank Passbook with photograph / Aadhaar / E-Aadhaar / Identity Card issued by recognised College/University / Gazetted Officer certificate) - bearing the same name as on the application / call letter. Ration Card and Learner’s Driving License are NOT valid.
  • Two passport-size photographs similar to the one used during portal registration
  • Any other relevant documents in support of eligibility

NO DOCUMENT SHOULD BE DIRECTLY SENT TO THE BANK BEFORE OR AFTER THE PROCESS. Printout of Application Form is NOT to be sent to the Bank. Candidates must appear for document verification at their own expense.

Apply Online at: https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ → Home Page → Recruitment → Relevant Notification

For queries: Email [email protected] | All revisions/corrigendum (if any) will be hosted on the Bank's website only.

Important Instructions for Punjab & Sind Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • THIS IS NOT AN EMPLOYMENT IN THE BANK. Candidates engaged as Apprentice will NOT be treated as "employees" of the Bank and will not be entitled to receive any benefits available for Bank employees.
  • The Bank shall have no obligation to offer regular employment to any Apprentice who has completed the period of training, nor shall the Apprentice be obligated to accept employment. The Apprentice shall have no right to claim employment in the Bank after completion of training.
  • Candidates can apply for only one State and one District, and not more than one application should be submitted. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained and fees for other registrations will stand forfeited.
  • Mandatory registration with 100% completed profile on both NAPS and NATS portals before applying on the Bank's website is required.
  • Candidates who had training or job experience of one or more years after completion of educational qualifications shall not be eligible for engagement as apprentice.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to reservation/relaxation; they should apply as General/UR.
  • Change of address / email ID / phone number / caste / category will not be entertained after submission of the application.
  • Signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be acceptable. The signature must be consistent across all documents and correspondence.
  • No daily allowance, conveyance allowance or travelling allowance will be paid to Apprentices. No overtime is permitted. Apprentices are entitled to only 1 casual leave per month (maximum 4 at a time).
  • The Contract of Apprenticeship shall terminate automatically on expiry of the 12-month training period. A non-performing apprentice will be given 7 days' notice. An apprentice wishing to terminate early must give 15 days' prior notice to the Bank.
  • Apprentices must devote their entire time exclusively to the Bank and shall not engage in any other commercial business, service, or advisory activity during the engagement period.
  • Apprentices must not disclose any financial information, data, concepts or internal communications relating to the Bank's business to any unauthorized person.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Any resultant dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Delhi.
  • Bank reserves the right to change/add/cancel the selection process or cancel the entire process at any stage without notice or refund of application fees.
  • All revisions/corrigendum (if any) will be hosted on the Bank's website only - candidates should visit regularly.

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply

Candidates must apply Online only through the Bank's official website. No other mode of application will be accepted. Before filling the application, candidates must mandatorily read the notification and instructions carefully.

Step-by-Step Application Process:

Step 1: Visit the Bank's official website https://www.bellarydcc.bank.in and open the link "BDCC RECRUITMENT 2026" on a desktop/laptop computer. Read the notification and instructions carefully before filling the application.

  • After clicking the registration box, a confirmation check box will appear for candidates who have previously applied and paid the fee. Those candidates must re-submit the application with the same registration number clearly mentioned, upload documents, and re-submit.
  • A check box will appear: "Are you re-applying after already submitting an application and fee payment?" If Yes, mention the previous application registration number clearly, upload documents, and re-submit the application.

Step 2: Visit http://www.bellarydcc.bank.in, register and log in. Enter your SSLC marks, name, date of birth, disability status, and other required details. Verify mobile number and email ID via OTP. Register successfully.

  • Candidates who previously applied and downloaded the application under the earlier notification must register again with a new registration number and re-upload documents per the new requirements. Fee once paid for the earlier application is not refunded, and no separate fee is required again for that post.

Step 3: Use your registration number and date of birth as login credentials. Review and edit all details and qualification information if needed. Preview the application carefully before confirming. Once submitted, no information can be changed.

Step 4: Upload Photo and Signature. The candidate must upload their passport-size photograph on a blank white paper with signature below using a black Sketch/Marker pen; scan and upload. Applications without photo/signature or incomplete applications will be rejected.

  • After uploading photo and signature, upload all required SSLC marks/reservation-related documents with self-attestation, then submit.

Step 5: After submitting, pay the application fee and applicable gateway charges through the Payment Gateway link.

Photo Specifications:

  • File size: Less than 100 KB
  • DPI Setting: 100 DPI
  • Quality: 100%
  • Color: Color
  • Format: JPG/JPEG
  • Photo size: 35mm × 45mm; Signature below: 35mm × 20mm

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents

The following documents must be uploaded online at the time of application and must be valid as on the last date of application. Originals must be produced at the time of verification.

For All Posts:

  1. Educational qualification certificates or mark sheets for the prescribed qualification (all years/semesters).
  2. SSLC marks card / School attendance certificate or Cumulative Record Extract (for date of birth proof).
  3. Category/reservation certificate as applicable.

For Reservation / Age Relaxation Certificates:

  1. Ex-Servicemen: Discharge certificate and Pension/Gratuity certificate from the authorized authority.
  2. SC/ST (Category A, B, C) / ST-Pangada candidates: Category certificates in the prescribed Government format - SC/ST in Form-D/E/F as applicable; Category-1 candidates in Form-E; 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates in Form-F issued by concerned Tahsildar.
  3. Candidates currently employed: Service certificate from employer and No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the relevant recruitment authority.
  4. Kalyana Karnataka Region candidates: Eligibility proof certificate as per Annexure-2 from the authorized sub-divisional authority.
  5. Rural candidates: Certificate in Form-1 and General candidates in Form-1 and Form-2 from the concerned Tahsildar.
  6. Differently-Abled candidates: Medical certificate from the District-level Medical Board in the prescribed Government format.
  7. Manager / First Division Assistant post: All year/semester mark sheets of the degree.
  8. Second Division Assistant post: Second PUC mark sheets / current student proof.
  9. Vehicle Driver post: SSLC marks card and valid legal driving license.
  10. Junior Servant post: SSLC marks card.
  11. Candidates applying for any post must mandatorily upload a self-portrait passport-size photograph with signature as described above.
  12. Candidates currently working anywhere must upload service certificate from the head of that organization and a No Objection Certificate.
  13. Rural / Ex-Servicemen / Kannada Medium / Differently-Abled category claimants must upload the competent authority-issued certificate.

Special Instructions for Previously Applied Candidates

  • Candidates who had applied and paid the fee under Bank Recruitment Notification No. 12:2026–27 dated 06.04.2026 and who wish to apply for the same posts in the current notification must mandatorily re-apply online. They must clearly mention the previous registration number and re-upload all required documents. No separate fee payment is required for those posts.

  • Candidates who had applied and downloaded the application under the 06.04.2026 notification must register freshly with a new registration number, re-submit, and upload documents as per current requirements. Once Application Re-submit is done, it cannot be re-edited and fees paid will not be refunded. Each post still requires a separate application; one Application Re-submit per post is allowed.
  • Information regarding re-application will be communicated via SMS and email to the registered mobile number and email ID of candidates who had previously applied and downloaded their application under the earlier notification.

Caste Reservation Certificate Requirements

For candidates claiming reservation benefits:

  • SC (Category A, B, C) / ST / Pangada candidates: Upload certificate in Form-D
  • Category-1 candidates: Upload certificate in Form-E
  • Category-2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates: Upload certificate in Form-F, obtained from the concerned Tahsildar; these certificates for Backward Hindu categories must be valid within 5 years from the date of application.

Rural Candidate Reservation:

  • Rural candidates must have studied from Class 1 to Class 10 in a village (rural area) under the current rules; certificate must be current and valid.
  • SC/ST/Pangada candidates claiming Rural reservation must submit Form-2 rural reservation certificate.
  • General category candidates claiming rural reservation must submit Form-1 rural certificate along with proof that they are not otherwise listed as urban.
  • General category, SC/ST/Pangada, Category-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates who fail to submit the required rural reservation certificate will be treated as ineligible for rural reservation.
  • Note: Certificate in Form-2 must be obtained from the Headmaster of the school where the candidate studied and attested by the concerned field education officer.

Kannada Medium Candidates:

  • Candidates claiming Kannada Medium reservation must submit a certificate from the Headmaster of the school where they studied Kannada medium along with date of school's issue, signed certificate, and must be held valid as on the last date of application. Original copies must be produced at verification. If not produced, the Kannada Medium reservation will be cancelled.

Scheme-Deprived (Yojane Nirashritha) Candidates:

  • Must produce a certificate from the concerned Tahsildar in the prescribed format as per current rules. Certificate must be valid up to the last date of application and must be current.

Ex-Servicemen:

  • Ex-Serviceman means a person who has served in any rank (combatant or non-combatant) in the Central Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force) - excluding persons who served in Defence Security Corps, General Reserve Engineering Force, Lok Sahayak Sena, and Para-Military Forces.
  • Family members (spouse/husband/wife and children, including adopted children) of persons who died while serving in Central Armed Forces are eligible for Ex-Servicemen reservation; however, age relaxation will not be provided to them.
  • Eligible cases for Ex-Servicemen reservation:
    • Retired voluntarily from such service after receiving pension; OR
    • Released from military service on medical grounds with medical and physical disability pension; OR
    • Released from service due to reduction of personnel; OR
    • Released from service after completing specific service and receiving gratuity, after fulfilling period of service - including: persons retired from continuous service, persons with physical disability due to military service, and gazette prize winners.
  • Persons currently re-employed in government service after retiring from military service must apply for military reservation through their current service NOC before appointment; they are allowed to enjoy all benefits available to ex-servicemen during re-employment, but the bank will not be responsible if they are not matched with the post. They must submit their discharge certificate before applying.
  • Ex-servicemen applicants, persons dependent on ex-servicemen who were killed or permanently disabled while in service - (spouse/husband/wife and children, including adopted children) - are eligible for Ex-Servicemen reservation benefits. Age relaxation will not be provided to dependents. They must submit the discharge certificate and permanence/gratuity certificate; at the time of original document verification, original copies must be produced.

Differently-Abled (Physically Challenged) Candidates:

  • Only candidates with a minimum of 40% benchmark disability certified by the District-level Medical Board in the prescribed Government format (NOT in any other format) are eligible for differently-abled reservation. Certificate must be issued in the prescribed Government notification format.
  • Differently-Abled candidates who require a scribe for the written examination must upload a special medical certificate from the Medical Board stating that they are unable to write due to physical disability.
  • The scribe requirement must be indicated at the time of application in the specified field in the online application; only when required, the candidate may request a scribe from the examination centre authority.

Who Should NOT Apply for Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not meet the prescribed educational qualifications (degree for Manager/FDA; Second PUC for SDA; SSLC for Driver and Junior Servant) as on the last date of application.

  • Candidates who cannot read, write, speak, and understand Kannada - knowledge of Kannada is mandatory for all posts.
  • Candidates below 18 years of age or above the maximum age limit applicable to their category.
  • OBC (Category-2A/2B/3A/3B) Creamy Layer candidates applying under reserved categories - only non-Creamy Layer OBC candidates are eligible for reservation.
  • Candidates with less than 40% disability who apply for Differently-Abled reservation - only 40%+ benchmark disability qualifies.
  • Vehicle Driver candidates who do not hold a valid legal driving license.
  • Candidates currently employed in any organization who cannot produce an NOC from their employer.
  • Candidates who obtained degrees or certificates from institutions declared fake or derecognized by competent educational authorities - such applications will be rejected at any stage.
  • Candidates who provide false information or suppress facts - such candidates are liable for criminal prosecution and disqualification at any stage of the selection process.
  • Persons who are members of or active in any banned organization, or who have attempted to overthrow the Government of India, or who have been convicted under any law, or who have taken part in activities against the sovereignty or integrity of India, or who have been dismissed from any government service.
  • Candidates with mental illness or mental disability.
  • A male candidate who has more than one living wife, and a woman candidate who has married a man who already has another living wife, are not eligible.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for the wrong post for which you do not meet the educational qualification.

  • Selecting the wrong category (General/SC/ST/OBC/EWS) - categories cannot be changed after submission; mismatched certificates lead to cancellation.
  • OBC (Backward Hindu 2A/2B/3A/3B) candidates from Creamy Layer applying under OBC reservation instead of General category.
  • Not uploading all mandatory documents at the time of online application - incomplete applications will be rejected outright.
  • Uploading blurred, illegible, or incorrect photographs, signatures, or certificates - leading to rejection at document verification stage.
  • Using an inactive or wrong mobile number and email ID - exam dates, interview schedules, and admit cards are communicated only through SMS and email.
  • Submitting multiple applications for the same post without following the proper Re-submit process - only the last valid application is considered and fees for others are forfeited.
  • Not reading the separate instructions for candidates who applied under the earlier notification (06.04.2026) - they must re-apply with their old registration number and need not pay fee again for the same post.
  • Not noting that each post requires a separate application and separate fee - applying for multiple posts with a single application/fee is not permitted.
  • Paying the fee through DD/Postal Order/Money Order or any offline mode - only online payment (Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI/Google Pay) is accepted.
  • Not keeping originals of all uploaded documents ready for verification - originals must be produced at the time of interview/verification.
  • Ignoring the minimum qualifying mark requirement: candidates must score a minimum of 85 out of 100 (or 200) in the written examination to qualify for the interview.

Important Instructions for Bellary DCC Bank  Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Applications must be submitted Online only at https://www.bellarydcc.bank.in; no other mode is accepted.

  • Candidates must mandatorily keep Kannada language proficiency - it is essential for all posts.
  • Information provided by candidates at the time of application regarding category, date of birth, educational qualification, age relaxation, etc., can only be for consideration purposes and will not be changed later; no request for change will be entertained afterward.
  • Incomplete applications, applications without photo/signature, or applications with incorrect information will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must self-attest all documents and mandatorily upload them online.
  • Candidates must keep a printout of the submitted application for their own reference.
  • Admit cards for the written examination and date/venue/time of interview will be communicated via SMS, email, or the Bank's website; admit cards will NOT be sent by post.
  • The Bank/external body reserves the right to advance, postpone, cancel, and change the rules of the recruitment process at any time without giving any reason.
  • The decision of the Bank's Board/Staff Recruitment Committee shall be final in all matters relating to recruitment; no correspondence will be entertained.
  • Candidates must serve a probation period of 2 years after selection.
  • Selected candidates will be provided security deposit and personal bond as informed by the Bank; they must sign a contract and pay the prescribed security deposit on joining.
  • This recruitment is subject to directions and orders of the Karnataka Government / High Court during the recruitment notification period.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • No correspondence regarding recruitment will be entertained from any candidate after the process has concluded.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be based on Written Test followed by Personal Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on written test performance will be called for Personal Interview. Final selection will be based on overall performance in both stages. Written Examination carries 70% weightage and Personal Interview carries 30% weightage in the final merit list. There will be no sectional cut-off in the written test. Exim Bank will analyse responses to detect patterns of similarity - if copying is inferred, candidature will be cancelled.

Stage 2 - Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted on the basis of written test performance will be called for Personal Interview at Mumbai or New Delhi. Candidates must produce original degree certificates, caste, experience and other relevant certificates at the time of interview. Candidates already in service must carry a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate from their present employer at the time of joining.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager (Information Security) Recruitment 2026 - Pre-Recruitment Training

A pre-recruitment training will be organized for candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online/offline) will be intimated to candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared after the last date of registration.

Who should NOT apply for Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not hold a full-time B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech./M.E./M.C.A. in Computer Science/IT/Electronics & Communication - degrees from other disciplines or part-time/distance/correspondence courses are strictly ineligible.
  • Candidates with aggregate marks below 60% in their qualifying degree - the 60% minimum is a hard eligibility condition.
  • Candidates who do not have at least 1 year of post-qualification experience in Information Security functions in a Scheduled Commercial Bank, All India Financial Institution, or other organization of repute - experience in unrelated IT roles does not qualify.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 21 to 28 years as on 01-05-2026 (except those entitled to OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen relaxation).
  • OBC Creamy Layer candidates expecting OBC reservation or age relaxation - they must apply as General.
  • Candidates not willing to serve anywhere in India - posting is at the Bank's requirement at any location in India including transfers to overseas offices with consent.
  • Candidates who cannot commit to the 5-year service bond of Rs. 3 lakh - this bond is mandatory and must be executed at the time of joining.
  • Candidates currently in government service who cannot produce a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate from their employer at the time of joining - they will not be allowed to join without it.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?

  • Uploading a signature in CAPITAL LETTERS - capital letter signatures are not accepted and will lead to rejection.
  • Not writing the handwritten declaration personally in English - if written by anyone else or in any other language, the application will be declared invalid.
  • Not uploading a live photograph via webcam/mobile at the time of filling the application - this is mandatory in addition to the static scanned photograph.
  • Uploading blurry, smudged, or unclear photograph, signature, left thumb impression, or handwritten declaration - such applications may be rejected; candidates should preview all uploads before final submission.
  • Not cross-checking that the name in the application exactly matches the name on the photo identity proof - any mismatch leads to denial of entry at the examination/interview; female candidates who have changed name post-marriage must be especially careful.
  • Clicking Back or Refresh during online fee payment - this may cause double charges; wait for server intimation after payment submission.
  • Not taking a printout of the e-Receipt and online application form after fee payment - this is required for future reference.
  • Not keeping the email ID and mobile number active till the end of the recruitment process - all communications including admit card, call letters, and results are sent only via email/SMS.
  • Not furnishing the CGPA conversion formula/letter from University/Institute if degree is CGPA-based - without this, the equivalent percentage cannot be verified and candidature may be rejected.
  • Waiting till the last date to apply - the Bank is not responsible for website outages or connectivity issues; candidates must apply well before 14-06-2026.

Exim Bank is recruiting 05 Management Trainee posts with MBA/PGDBA/PGDBM/MMS qualification, last date 14 June 2026.

Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 05 Management Trainee vacancies have been announced on Direct Recruitment basis across two disciplines. Reservation is applicable as per prevailing Government of India guidelines. One vacancy is reserved for PwBD (Hearing Impairment) on horizontal basis. The Bank reserves the right to revise the number of vacancies without further notice.

Post Name UR OBC (NCL) Total
Management Trainee - Human Resource Management 02 01 03
Management Trainee - Administration 01 01 02
Total 03 02 05

Abbreviations: UR - Unreserved, OBC (NCL) - Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer), PwBD - Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. PwBD reservation is horizontal within overall vacancies; selected PwBD candidates will be adjusted against the category to which they belong. Only candidates with not less than 40% of relevant disability are eligible for PwBD reservation. SC/ST vacancies not notified in this advertisement. Reservations as per prevailing GoI guidelines.

Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the date of eligibility. Only Indian Citizens are eligible to apply. Candidates having completed graduation and postgraduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance learning are NOT eligible. All qualifications must be from a University/Institution recognised/approved by Government / AICTE / UGC.

Post Essential Academic Qualification
Management Trainee - Human Resource Management (03 Posts) Minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course) AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Human Resource Management / Personnel Management (minimum 2-year full-time course) with minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in both Graduation and Post Graduation.
Management Trainee - Administration (02 Posts) Option 1: Minimum 60% in Graduation (3-year full-time) AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Hotel and Hospitality Management / Facilities Management or equivalent (2-year full-time), with minimum 60% in both Graduation and Post Graduation.

Option 2: Minimum 60% in B.Tech in Civil Engineering AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) in any discipline, both full-time, with minimum 60% marks.

Note: Candidates who have appeared in their final qualifying examinations and are awaiting results are eligible to appear in the Written Examination. However, the offer to join shall be subject to production of necessary documents evidencing successful completion of requisite qualification by 01-06-2026 or the joining date prescribed by the Bank (whichever is later). Candidates from universities/institutes awarding CGPA/GPA must furnish a letter from the Head of Institute/Controller of Examination indicating the conversion formula from grades to percentage, if equivalent percentage is not mentioned in their marksheet.

Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be a minimum of 21 years and maximum of 28 years as on 30-04-2026. Maximum age indicated is for General (Unreserved) candidates. Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates.

Category Maximum Age Limit
General (UR) 28 Years (as on 30-04-2026)
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 31 Years (3 years relaxation as per GoI guidelines)
PwBD (Persons with Disabilities) 10 years relaxation over respective category limit (as per GoI guidelines)
Ex-Servicemen 5 years relaxation (as per GoI guidelines)

Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates are required to pay non-refundable Application Fees / Intimation Charges through online mode only from 15 May 2026 to 14 June 2026. Bank transaction charges for online payment will be borne by the candidate. The registration process is complete only when fee is deposited through online mode on or before the last date. Fees once paid will not be refunded on any account.

Category Fees / Intimation Charges
General / OBC Rs. 600/- (Non-Refundable)
SC / ST / PwBD / EWS / Female Candidates Rs. 100/- (Intimation Charges only)

Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will comprise a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on performance in the Written Test will be called for Personal Interview. Final selection will be based on overall performance in both stages. No sectional cut-off will be applied in the Written Test; the final merit list will be drawn based on marks in Written Examination (out of 100 with 70% weightage) and Interview (out of 100 with 30% weightage).

Stage 1 - Written Test (Subjective)

Part Description Marks Duration
Part I Subject Matter Knowledge - HR / Administration (Compulsory Question) 40 02 hours 30 minutes
Part II Attempt any 6 out of 8 Questions (HR / Administration) 60
Total 100

The Written Test is a Professional Knowledge - Subjective paper. There is no negative marking. Though the duration of the examination is 2 hours 30 minutes, candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including time for verification and completion of various formalities. Candidates reporting late after the reporting time specified on the call letter will not be permitted to take the examination.

Stage 2 - Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted from the Written Test will be called for Personal Interview to be conducted in Mumbai and/or New Delhi. Candidates must carry original and photocopy of valid photo identity proof along with the Interview Call Letter. The Bank's decision on shortlisting and final selection shall be final and binding.

Competition Level Analysis for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

The competition level for Exim Bank MT Recruitment 2026 is expected to be very intense given that only 05 vacancies are on offer across two disciplines from a large pool of MBA/PGDBM graduates across India. The Bank being a premier financial institution under the Government of India makes this an exceptionally sought-after position among finance, HR, and administration postgraduates. The subjective Written Test format — unlike the MCQ-based bank exams — demands strong subject knowledge, analytical writing ability, and command over HR / Administration concepts rather than just speed and aptitude.

The low vacancy count means even marginal differences in written test scores will determine shortlisting for the interview round. Candidates with domain depth in HRM/Personnel Management (for MT-HRM) or Hotel/Facilities/Civil background with MBA (for MT-Administration) are better positioned. The Personal Interview carrying 30% of the final weightage means soft skills, subject clarity, and awareness of Exim Bank's functions and India's international trade ecosystem will be critical differentiators at the final stage.

Who should NOT apply for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who have completed their graduation or postgraduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance learning; they are categorically not eligible.
  • Candidates who do not hold a Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) in the relevant specialization with minimum 60% marks in both graduation and post graduation.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 21-28 years as on 30-04-2026 (except as per OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen relaxation).
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer; they must apply as General candidates. OBC certificate must be valid as on the last date of applying (issued within one year prior to the last date).
  • Candidates who have defaulted in any loan repayment and/or whose name appears in CIBIL database as a defaulter.
  • Candidates unwilling to serve anywhere in India or unwilling to be transferred to offices outside India (with consent).
  • Candidates unwilling to execute a personal bond of Rs. 3 lakh to serve the Bank for 1 year as MT and minimum 5 years as employee after absorption.
  • Currently serving employees of Government / PSU who cannot produce a proper Relieving Letter/Discharge Certificate from their present employer at the time of joining.
  • Candidates whose CGPA-based qualification does not include an equivalent percentage conversion letter from the Head of Institute/Controller of Examination (if percentage is not mentioned in marksheet).

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for MT-HRM without specialization in Human Resource Management / Personnel Management, or applying for MT-Administration without the prescribed qualification combinations.
  • Not checking whether your graduation and postgraduation are from a full-time regular programme; part-time/distance mode graduates are not eligible even if the university is recognized.
  • Entering less than 60% marks in either graduation or postgraduation; both must independently meet the 60% threshold.
  • OBC candidates applying with an expired caste certificate; OBC NCL certificate must be issued within one year prior to the last date of applying and must contain the non-creamy layer clause.
  • Uploading blurred/incorrect photo, signature, left thumb impression, or handwritten declaration; any mismatch or unclear document can lead to rejection.
  • Writing the handwritten declaration in capital letters or in a language other than English; both will render the application invalid.
  • Using an inactive or incorrect mobile number/email ID, causing missed notifications for call letters, exam updates, or interview communication.
  • Pressing the BACK or REFRESH button during the online payment process, which may result in double charge or payment failure.
  • Not noting down the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated at the time of registration; required for re-login if application is saved midway.
  • Submitting application without verifying that the name as filled in the form exactly matches the name on photo identity proof; any mismatch will lead to disqualification at the exam/interview stage.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online only from 15 May 2026 to 14 June 2026 through the link available at https://www.eximbankindia.in/careers. No other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date and not wait till the last date. Before applying, candidates must scan and keep ready all required documents as per specifications mentioned in the notification.

Documents Required to be Scanned and Uploaded:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm; 200×230 pixels; 20 KB-50 KB; JPEG)
  • Signature with black ink on white paper (140×60 pixels; 10 KB-20 KB; JPEG) — not in CAPITAL LETTERS
  • Left Thumb Impression on white paper with black or blue ink (240×240 pixels; 200 DPI; 20 KB-50 KB; JPG/JPEG)
  • Handwritten Declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels; 200 DPI; 50 KB-100 KB; JPG/JPEG) — in candidate's own handwriting only, not in capital letters. Text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Live photograph captured via webcam or mobile phone (to be captured at the time of online application)
  • Consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation (PDF; 20 KB-500 KB)
  • Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree Certificate (PDF; 20 KB-500 KB)
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable) (PDF; 20 KB-500 KB)

Documents to be Produced at the time of Written Examination / Personal Interview:

  • Call Letter (downloaded from Bank's website) along with original and photocopy of valid photo identity proof (PAN Card / Passport / Permanent Driving License / Voter's Card / Bank Passbook with photograph / Aadhaar Card / E-Aadhaar / Employee ID / Bar Council Identity Card with photograph / Photo identity proof issued by a Gazetted Officer or People's Representative on official letterhead)
  • Original Degree Certificates and Mark Sheets (Graduation and Post-Graduation)
  • Caste Certificate in prescribed format (for OBC candidates — must contain NCL clause, issued within one year prior to last date of applying)
  • Disability Certificate issued by authority as prescribed in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017 (for PwBD candidates)
  • In case of name change after passing High School — original Gazette notification / marriage certificate / affidavit in original
  • CGPA conversion letter from Head of Institute/Controller of Examination (if equivalent percentage is not mentioned in marksheet)
  • Relieving Letter/Discharge Certificate from present employer (for candidates already in service — to be produced at the time of joining)

Note: Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are NOT valid identity proof. Candidates must ensure the name on the Call Letter exactly matches the name on the photo identity proof.

Apply Online at: https://www.eximbankindia.in/careers

For queries: Regularly check https://www.eximbankindia.in/careers for details and updates. Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction of courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai only.

Important Instructions for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • The application link will be live from 15 May 2026; no application in any other format or mode will be considered.
  • The registration process is complete only when fee is deposited through online mode on or before the last date; incomplete applications or applications without fee (except exempt categories) are liable to be rejected.
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfil all eligibility criteria before paying fee/submitting application; fees once paid will not be refunded even if the applicant is found ineligible.
  • Management Trainees will be absorbed as Deputy Managers (JM-I) after successful completion of one year of training, subject to satisfactory performance.
  • At the time of joining, selected candidates must execute a personal bond of Rs. 3 lakh to serve as Management Trainee for 1 year and minimum 5 years as an employee of the Bank after absorption.
  • Selected candidates will be posted anywhere in India; candidates willing to serve anywhere in India only should apply. They may also be transferred to offices outside India with their consent.
  • The Bank will analyse responses of candidates to detect similarity patterns; if scores are found not genuine/valid, the Bank reserves the right to cancel the candidature.
  • Final merit list will be based on Written Examination (70% weightage) and Personal Interview (30% weightage).
  • There will be no sectional cut-off in the Written Test; shortlisting for interview will be based on overall performance in the Written Test.
  • A pre-recruitment training will be organised for candidates from reserved categories; details will be intimated to candidates who opt for it in the online application form.
  • PwBD candidates eligible for scribe facility must indicate the same in the online application form at the time of applying; subsequent requests may not be entertained. Scribe must be arranged by the candidate at their own cost. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination will be allowed for eligible PwBD candidates using a scribe.
  • Mobile phones or similar electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited inside the examination/interview hall.
  • No request for change of examination centre/venue/date/session will be entertained.
  • Candidates must carry the call letter and original photo identity proof to both the Written Test and Personal Interview without fail; absence of either will result in denial of entry.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage without assigning any reason.
  • All legal proceedings in respect of any claim/dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be instituted only in Mumbai; courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.

The engaged Concurrent Auditor will work at branches/outfits under the supervision of the GM(IA) of the respective CAO.

  • Wrong subject line: The email subject must say exactly - Post applied for: CLERK - without this, your email may not get categorised correctly.
  • Sending only a resume without the data format: The notification specifically asks for both resume AND the listed data points. Send both.
  • Using a casual or unprofessional email ID: Use a proper email ID (firstname.lastname format) - your application email is also your contact for all future communications.

  • Applying from outside the eligible locations: Only Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, and Gujarat residents are eligible. Candidates from other cities should not apply.
  • Percentage discrepancy: Enter your correct percentage - it will be verified against your original marksheet during document verification. Even a small mismatch can lead to disqualification and fee forfeiture.

Common Issues & Solutions While Downloading City Slip

Issue 1: Unable to Login / Invalid Credentials Error

Solutions:

  • Verify your registration number carefully (no spaces before/after)
  • Check date of birth format: DD/MM/YYYY (e.g., 15/08/1998)
  • Ensure CAPS LOCK is off while entering details
  • Clear your browser cache and cookies (Ctrl+Shift+Del)
  • Try using a different web browser (Chrome, Firefox, or Edge)
  • Use "Forgot Registration Number" link if you don't remember it
  • Check your registered email for registration confirmation

Issue 2: City Slip Not Showing / Page Not Loading

Solutions:

  • Verify if city slip is released for your specific exam date
  • Try downloading during non-peak hours (early morning 6-8 AM or late night 11 PM onwards)
  • Disable VPN, proxy, or ad-blocker extensions
  • Check your internet connection stability
  • Try using mobile data instead of WiFi (or vice versa)
  • Use incognito/private browsing mode
  • Update your web browser to the latest version
  • Try accessing from mobile app if available

Issue 3: Error in Details Displayed on City Slip

Solutions:

  • Contact Railway Recruitment Board helpdesk immediately
  • Email to: [email protected] with screenshot
  • Call helpline: 080-4719-2000 (working hours: 10 AM - 5 PM)
  • Keep your registration number and application details ready
  • Explain the exact discrepancy in detail
  • Request for correction before exam date

Issue 4: PDF Download Not Working

Solutions:

  • Take a screenshot of the city slip as backup
  • Try "Print to PDF" option (Ctrl+P then save as PDF)
  • Use a different PDF reader (Adobe Acrobat Reader)
  • Check if pop-ups are blocked in browser settings
  • Ensure sufficient storage space on device
  • Try downloading from different device

Issue 5: Captcha Not Visible or Loading

Solutions:

  • Refresh the page (F5 key)
  • Enable JavaScript in browser settings
  • Disable browser extensions temporarily
  • Use a different browser
  • Clear browser cache completely

City Intimation Slip vs Admit Card - Key Differences

Many candidates confuse city intimation slip with admit card. Here's a clear comparison to understand the differences:

Aspect City Intimation Slip Admit Card / Hall Ticket
Purpose Advance information only for travel planning Mandatory entry document for examination
Release Time 7-10 days before exam date 4 days before exam date
Information Provided Exam city, date, shift timing only Complete center address, roll number, photo, signature
Can you enter exam hall? NO - Not permitted YES - Mandatory requirement
Contains Photo No Yes
Contains Roll Number No  Yes
Exam Center Address Only city name Complete address with venue details
Use for Travel Booking Yes - Use for advance planning Can use after release
Barcode/QR Code Usually not present Present for verification
Exam Instructions General instructions Detailed exam day instructions

Critical Warning: You CANNOT enter the examination hall with only the city intimation slip. You MUST download and carry the admit card (available 4 days before exam) along with a valid photo ID proof to appear for the exam.

Eligibility Code for NTA NEET 2026 UG

  • NEET UG Code 01: A candidate who is appearing in the qualifying examination, i.e., 12 Standard in 2025 whose result is awaited may apply and take up the said test but he/she shall not be eligible for admission to the MBBS or BDS, if he/she does not pass the qualifying examination with the required pass percentage of marks at the time of first round of Counseling.
  • NEET UG Code 02 : The Higher/Senior Secondary Examination or the Indian School Certificate Examination which is equivalent to 10+2 Higher/Senior Secondary Examination after a period of 12 years study, the last two years of such study comprising of Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Bio-technology (which shall include practical tests in these subjects) and Mathematics or any other elective subject with English at a level not less than the core course for English as prescribed by the National Council of Educational Research and Training after introduction of the 10+2+3 educational structure as recommended by the National Committee on Education.
  • NEET UG Code 03 : The Intermediate/Pre-degree Examination in Science of an Indian University/Board or other recognized examining body with Physics, Chemistry, Biology /Bio-technology (which shall include practical test in these subjects) and also English as a compulsory subject
  • NEET UG Code 04 : The Pre-professional/Pre-medical Examination with Physics ,Chemistry, Biology/Bio-technology & English after passing either the Higher Secondary Examination or the Pre-University or an equivalent examination. The Pre-professional/Pre-medical examination shall include practical test in these subjects and also English as a compulsory subject.
  • NEET UG Code 05 : The first year of the three years’ degree course of a recognized University with Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Bio-technology including practical tests in these subjects provided the examination is a University Examination and candidate has passed the earlier qualifying examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Bio-Technology with English at a level not less than a core course.
  • NEET UG Code 06 : B.Sc.Examination of an Indian University provided that he/she has passed the B.Sc.Examination with not less than two of the subjects Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Botany, Zoology)/Bio-technology and further that he/she has passed the earlier qualifying examination with Physics,Chemistry,Biology and English.
  • NEET UG Code 07: Any other examination which in scope and standard (Last 02 years of 10+2 Study
    comprising of Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Biotechnology; which shall include
    practical test in these subjects) is found to be equivalent to the Intermediate Science
    Examination of an Indian University/Board, taking Physics, Chemistry and
    Biology/Biotechnology including practical tests in each of these subjects and English.



Important Instruction for NEET UG

  • Aadhar Card is Compulsory in All India NTA NEET 2026 Examination

  • Background  and Also Enter Your Candidates Name and Photo Taken Date after 01/01/2026

You will be the person our clients rely on to actually get them interviews. This is a high-ownership, execution-first role where you manage 10 or more clients at a time, each at different stages of their job search. Our clients are not freshers. Many are Directors, VPs, and senior professionals who expect sharp, thoughtful work. We have SOPs. You will follow them. But the SOPs do not make every decision for you. When a client is a VP of Engineering targeting a Head of Product role at a Series B, you need to know that the right person to reach out to is the CTO or a senior technical recruiter, not an HR coordinator. That kind of judgment is what this role runs on. Key responsibilities: 1. Manage an active portfolio of 10 or more clients simultaneously, each with their own target roles, timelines, and priorities. 2. Research and identify relevant job opportunities across LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, and Glassdoor for each client based on their profile. 3. Find the right decision-makers at target companies while carefully matching seniority levels. 4. Source and verify recruiter and hiring manager email addresses using enrichment tools. 5. Set up and schedule personalized cold email outreach sequences and follow-ups for each client. 6. Manage and monitor client LinkedIn profiles, including activity, messaging, and profile presentation. 7. Conduct regular LinkedIn audits and share structured feedback and improvement recommendations. 8. Generate weekly or bi-weekly client reports covering outreach sent, opens, replies, interviews scheduled, and pipeline status. 9. Track each client’s application pipeline from saved to applied to interviewing and keep records updated. 10. Communicate proactively with clients when attention or input is required. 11. Flag patterns, blockers, or client issues to internal leads before they become problems. What we are looking for: 1. 1 to 3 years of experience in recruitment, HR tech, career services, client operations, executive assistance, or a similar field. 2. Strong understanding of the job search process and practical hiring workflows. 3. Strong written English skills for writing client-facing emails and reports. 4. Comfortable working with LinkedIn, spreadsheets, email clients, and new SaaS tools. 5. High ownership mindset with the ability to manage deliverables independently. 6. Ability to handle multiple clients and priorities simultaneously without missing deadlines. 7. Good understanding of corporate hierarchy and stakeholder targeting. 8. Previous startup experience is a strong plus. 9. Familiarity with ATS systems, cold email tools, or LinkedIn outreach is a strong plus. What good looks like at 90 days: 1. Managing a full client portfolio independently with minimal escalations. 2. Ensuring client reports and outreach activities are delivered consistently on time. 3. Proactively flagging edge cases and judgment calls instead of making assumptions or remaining silent. 4. Helping clients receive replies and schedule interviews successfully.

Successful candidates communicate effectively, think critically to resolve issues, are eager to learn, are open to feedback, and champion the SonderMind brand in a fully remote environment. This is an excellent opportunity for those with care coordination experience, recent college graduates, or people seeking a meaningful career change in a high-growth organization.

In this role you will act as the first point of contact for clients seeking care through SonderMind or payor partners. Manage intake, provider matching, and client account completion from initial outreach through appointment scheduling. This fast-paced, high-volume team is well-suited for individuals who enjoy critical thinking, empathetic client interactions, and navigating technical systems to deliver a strong client experience.

What Youâll Do

  • Provide primary support for clients seeking care to manage their mental and behavioral health wellness.
  • Utilize a variety of technologies to ensure the client is connected with the appropriate therapist and maintains the required support through an episode of care.
  • Utilize a consultative approach to assist with identifying the correct provider for care.
  • Manage inbound and outbound calls and other forms of communication while applying standard guidelines to address or route messages to the appropriate care team member for follow-up when necessary.
  • Interact with external partners and healthcare systems to ensure access to care.
  • Conduct outreach to referred clients and provide personalized onboarding services and assistance with all aspects of getting into care.
  • Assist with care coordination tasks such as appointment scheduling and facilitating communication with providers and other care team members.
  • And other responsibilities and ad-hoc projects from time to time based on business needs.

What does success look like?

  • Within two weeks, fully understand our client journey and be able to support the client onboarding experience and share the benefits of choosing SonderMind to achieve their mental health goals.
  • Within three weeks, understand SonderMind's technology platform and how to provide support for SonderMind clients.
  • Within one month, fully support new client requests and inquiries via phone, email, and form submissions. Ongoing ability to effectively answer questions and requests from our new clients and effectively hit defined goals and targets.
  • Ongoing ability to adapt to the change in workflow and job tasks.
  • Ongoing proactive identification of problems and asking questions to clarify and help solve problems.

Who You Are

  • Strong desire to assist clients and provide support to those seeking mental health care
  • Ability to work with people in vulnerable situations (in states of crisis, or going through difficult times)
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal and able to communicate professionally
  • Motivated and eager to learn, ability to adapt to new technologies, processes, and workflows
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Flexibility to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Goal-oriented with a strong drive to achieve results
  • Team-work oriented; always willing and ready to help assist other team members.
  • Eagerness to engage with internal team members and other departments professionally
  • Openness to feedback and a commitment to personal and professional development
  • Ability to use and exhaust all resources when met with unique challenges

Equal Opportunity

SonderMind does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, color, creed, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, religion, veteran and military status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including genetic information or characteristics), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Our Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $21.64/hr. In addition to base compensation, this role is also eligible for a variable bonus and equity.

As leaders in redesigning behavioral health, we walk the walk with our employees' benefits. We want the experience of working at SonderMind to accelerate peopleâs careers and enrich their lives, so we focus on meeting SonderMinders wherever they are and supporting them in all facets of their lives and work.

Our benefits include:

  • A commitment to fostering flexible hybrid work
  • A generous PTO policy with a minimum of three weeks off per year
  • Free therapy coverage benefits to ensure our employees have access to the care they need (must be enrolled in our medical plans to participate)
  • Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage with plans to meet every need, including HSA ($1,100 company contribution) and FSA options
  • Employer-paid short-term, long-term disability, life & AD&D to cover life's unexpected events. Not only that, we also cover the difference in salary for up to seven (7) weeks of short-term disability leave (after the required waiting period) should you need to use it.
  • Eight weeks of paid Parental Leave (if the parent also qualifies for STD, this benefit is in addition, which allows between 8-16 weeks of paid leave)
  • 401K retirement plan with 100% matching which immediately vests on up to 4% of base salary
  • Company paid holidays
  • Supplemental life insurance, pet insurance coverage, commuter benefits and more!

Application Deadline

This position will be an ongoing recruitment process and will be open until filled.

AI & Our Hiring Process

At SonderMind, we use technology, including AI-assisted tools, to support our recruiting process. These tools help us operate efficiently and provide a consistent, timely experience for every candidate. They may assist our team with activities such as scheduling interviews, taking notes and transcriptions, organizing candidate information, and coordinating outreach. In the course of using these tools, we may process the personal and professional information you share with us as part of your application.

All hiring decisions at SonderMind, including whether to advance, reject, or extend an offer to a candidate, are made by members of our recruiting and hiring teams. We do not rely on automated systems to make these decisions about candidates.

We are committed to a fair and equitable process.   • USD Vault â borrows BTC against sBTCD for 12â19% APY in dollar terms, with zero BTC price risk to the depositor.
  • BTC Vault â borrows USD against sBTCD for 6â14% APY denominated in BTC, preserving full Bitcoin exposure.

Depositors simply choose USDC or wBTC; the vaults handle leverage, rebalancing, and risk. Today, that engine drives BTCD TVL. Tomorrow it powers a family of assets â an ETH Dollar, a HYPE Dollar, an XRP Dollar and beyond â each a new productive collateral primitive on the same rails.

The protocol is live, audited, and in market, built by crypto leaders from Coinme, Bullish, ShapeShift, Credora, and ether.fi, and backed by Polygon Labs and Coinme.

Role Overview

We are hiring a founding CEO to own capital formation, TVL growth, and the FISC token economy. This is not a foundation steward role and not a TradFi executive seat. It is a hands-on, commercial, crypto-native operating role for someone who has personally scaled a DeFi protocol, knows tokenomics as a craft, has credibility with curators, funds and risk firms and can champion a vision for the ecosystem online and onstage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own TVL growth across token demand, staking, and vault deposits â and set, track, and report the growth and financial metrics that govern it.
  • Lead capital formation end-to-end â raise the Series A from crypto-native investors and secure the seed liquidity and incentive capital needed to bootstrap and retain TVL.
  • Own the FISC token economy and capital-markets strategy â tokenomics, emissions, points and incentive programs, liquidity mining, and bribe-market deployment.
  • Convert and deepen the curator and risk pipeline â turn warm relationships into live, endorsed integrations. Curator trust is the protocol's #1 conversion unlock.
  • Build the capital stack beyond the raise â crypto hedge funds, LPs, and ecosystem partners now; institutional and TradFi allocators as the platform matures.
  • Be the public face of Bitcoin Dollar and FISC â conferences, podcasts, Twitter Spaces, and forums â carrying a credible, transparent narrative.
  • Drive the trust-infrastructure agenda â real-time Proof of Reserves, DeFiLlama and aggregator listings, public risk assessments, and curator endorsements â and forge integrations (Pendle, Morpho, Aave, cross-chain) that extend sBTCD composability and distribution.
  • Lead a small, senior team â hire selectively, set the operating cadence, manage runway and burn, and steward the long-term roadmap toward the multi-asset "Dollar" family, FISC seasons, and DAO governance.

Qualifications

  • Personally drove measurable TVL or AUM growth at a DeFi protocol with specific, defensible numbers
  • Deep crypto-capital-markets fluency â tokenomics and incentive design, lending markets, vaults, leverage, PT/YT and bribe markets, liquidity provisioning, and on-chain analytics.
  • Credible, existing curator and risk-firm relationships, with a proven ability to convert skeptics into live integrations.
  • Demonstrated fundraising â you've raised from crypto VCs and/or allocated as an investor, and can run a Series A.
  • A strong public presence â comfortable as the named face of a protocol on stage, on podcasts, and on X â able to explain novel yield and rebalancing mechanics to a sophisticated, skeptical audience.
  • A player-coach who thrives hands-on in a sub-20-person senior team and builds the playbook rather than managing a large org.
  • High integrity and conviction, genuine comfort with token-weighted comp and early-stage ambiguity, and sound regulatory awareness as the public executive of a Cayman non-profit foundation and token issuer.

Nice to Have

  • Direct working relationships with curators like Re7, Block Analitica, Gauntlet, Steakhouse, or Veda
  • Prior founder or CEO experience at a DeFi protocol
  • Stablecoin, yield, or RWA protocol depth
  • Network into Pendle, Morpho, Aave, or Sky ecosystems

About the Role

The Writer is the voice behind Martell Groupâs written content, responsible for crafting copy, captions, scripts, and written assets that perform across every platform and content format.

This role requires the ability to write in distinct brand voices without defaulting to generic or AI-sounding content. This is not a position for someone who relies entirely on AI to generate copy. The ideal candidate is a strategic creative who understands the weight every word carries in shaping a powerful brand.

Beyond captions and social copy, the Writer contributes to long-form scripts, newsletters, email campaigns, promotional copy, and any written asset tied to brand communication or content performance. They work closely with the Social Producer and Creative Producer to ensure written content aligns with visual direction, platform strategy, and audience expectations.

This role is focused on maintaining brand consistency while intelligently integrating AI tools to increase output, accelerate ideation, and improve workflow efficiency without compromising quality or authenticity.

The Writer reports directly to the Creative Producer and may work fully remotely.

Responsibilities

Social Copy & Captions

  • Write platform-native captions for Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, YouTube, and Threads
  • Develop compelling hooks, CTAs, and caption structures that drive engagement and retention
  • Adapt tone, structure, and formatting based on platform-specific best practices
  • Maintain a strong and consistent brand voice across all channels

Script & Long-Form Writing

  • Write or refine scripts for YouTube episodes, short-form videos, and branded content
  • Develop repeatable written frameworks for recurring content formats and series
  • Support the Creative Producer with written briefs, outlines, and episode structures
  • Write titles, descriptions, and metadata optimized for SEO, AEO, and GEO discoverability

Promotional & Campaign Copy

  • Write copy for episode launches, campaigns, newsletters, and promotional initiatives
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to align messaging with funnel strategy and campaign goals
  • Support paid ad creative copy when needed in collaboration with marketing
  • Work alongside the internal PR team and communications manager on quotes and external communications

Brand Voice & Standards

  • Maintain and evolve brand voice guidelines
  • Build and manage a living brand voice library, including signature phrases and messaging references that support scalable, authentic content creation
  • Ensure all written output from internal teams, contractors, and vendors aligns with established brand standards
  • Identify off-brand messaging and provide clear corrective direction

AI Integration

  • Use AI tools to accelerate first drafts, generate variations, and test hooks or messaging angles
  • Build and maintain prompt libraries and writing systems that improve team efficiency
  • Identify opportunities where AI can reduce low-value writing tasks without sacrificing quality or brand integrity

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Social Producer to align captions with video content and visual framing
  • Coordinate with the design team to ensure copy and visuals work cohesively
  • Collaborate with the Creative Producer on voice direction, content priorities, and writing standards

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in copywriting, content writing, or brand writing for digital media or personal brands
  • Proven ability to write in multiple distinct voices while maintaining authenticity and quality
  • Strong understanding of social platform behavior and high-performing copy formats
  • Experience writing video scripts, captions, newsletters, and long-form content at scale
  • Exceptional attention to detail with a strong sense of clarity, rhythm, and persuasion
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with multiple concurrent projects
  • Proficiency with AI writing tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, or equivalent platforms, or a demonstrated drive to integrate AI into daily workflows
  • Strong collaborator who takes direction well and communicates creative feedback clearly

Results

  • Assigned brands maintain consistent, on-brand written communication across all active platforms
  • Caption and hook performance improves measurably through engagement and click-through metrics
  • Scripts and long-form written assets are delivered on schedule without creating production bottlenecks
  • Brand voice guidelines are documented, maintained, and actively referenced by the team
  • The Creative Producer spends less time editing and rewriting, allowing for greater focus on creative strategy
  • AI is effectively integrated into the writing workflow, increasing output speed while maintaining quality and authenticity
